title: Technicien / Technicienne de maintenance en matériels informatiqu (H/F)
description:
Role Requirements & Responsibilities :

Field Execution and Technical Delivery :
- Attend client sites on time with all required equipment, PPE, documentation, and job readiness.
- Lead complex fibre and copper cabling installations across multi-rack, multi-room, or multi-phase deployments.
- Execute structured cabling tasks including routing, termination, dressing, patching, and cross-connects in live data centre environments.
- Validate job readiness before execution including materials, access approvals, drawings, risk assessments, and site conditions.
- Provide technical input into daily task sequencing and execution planning in coordination with Supervisors.
- Resolve non-standard field issues and implement corrective actions in line with customer standards.
- Ensure all installations follow approved methodologies, design documentation, and safety requirements..

Quality, Testing, and Documentation:
- Validate cable routing, dressing, labeling, and patching accuracy during and after execution.
- Support preparation, execution, and review of fibre and copper testing activities.
- Review test outputs and highlight deviations or quality risks to Supervisors.
- Maintain accurate cable schedules, as-built documentation, and task reporting.
- Identify quality gaps and initiate corrective actions in coordination with Supervisors and Project Leads.

Team Support and Coordination :
- Provide technical guidance and support to field teams during complex tasks.
- Act as technical escalation point for on-site cabling issues.
- Communicate progress, risks, and constraints clearly to Supervisors and Project Leads.
- Represent professionally in all customer-facing site interactions.

Safety and Compliance :
- Ensure compliance with all customer health, safety, and security procedures.
- Identify and escalate safety risks or non-compliant practices immediately.
- Support safety briefings and on-site adherence to operational rules..

The role requires flexibility and adaptability to changing situations and customer requirements, so the candidate must be comfortable working under pressure and on strict timelines. The candidate must be adaptable while performing tasks, ready to change priorities and maintain professional communications with clients, colleagues and vendors.

The successful candidate will be required to possess and demonstrate the following:
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills with high levels of attention to detail.
- Prior experience with the installation of structured cabling including fibre and copper.
- Strong understanding of structured cabling standards, pathways, and installation methodologies.
- Experience working in live data centre environments.
- Valid class B driving licence with a good driving record where travel is required.
- Basic experience with hand and power tools.
- Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, and Email.
- Language proficiency at minimum B1 level in English.
- Proficiency in another European language would be advantageous..
The following qualifications, skills and experience would be an advantage.
- Minimum 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in data centre cabling operations.
- Strong troubleshooting capability across fibre, copper, containment, and rack environments.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, patching matrices, and test documentation.
- Demonstrated ability to lead field execution technically without formal line management.
- Experience mentoring junior technicians.
- Ability to travel for work across customer sites.

title: Occitan text provider / éditeur d'ancien occitan (H/F)
description:
L'Université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry (UMPV) est une université des Humanités : Lettres, Langues, Arts, Sciences Humaines et Sociales. Plus de 22 000 étudiants sont inscrits de la licence au doctorat et 240 diplômes en lien avec les besoins socio-économiques y sont préparés.

Université citoyenne et durable, dont le site principal est installé sur un campus arboré de plus de 10 hectares labellisé Patrimoine du XXe siècle, elle est dotée d'équipements pédagogiques exceptionnels, tels le Musée des Moulages classé, le Théâtre La Vignette « scène conventionnée pour l'émergence et la diversité », le Learning center ATRIUM conçu comme un lieu de savoir vivant, modernisant la fonction de bibliothèque universitaire et les services aux étudiants.

Contexte du recrutement
Projet SRC 2026-1 MIRANDA : Digital Occitan Paleography

Ce projet s'inscrit dans le cadre d'un partenariat de longue date avec les Archives de Montpellier Métropole et s'intéresse au Registre du clavaire, livre de comptes de la ville, rédigé en 1357-1358.
Son objectif est d'offrir une transcription complète de ce livre manuscrit inédit en formant des étudiants avancés d'une part à la paléographie de l'occitan médiéval et, d'autre part, à une utilisation correcte de l'intelligence artificielle. Grâce à la plateforme open source eScriptorium, système de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite (HTR), il sera en effet possible d'entraîner l'IA à lire correctement l'occitan (principe du deep learning). Le programme se déroulera de septembre 2026 à mars 2027. En voici le calendrier : recrutement des stagiaires en septembre, installation et apprentissage des outils en octobre, colloque ouvert au public pour présenter les résultats de cette expérience fin mars. Les données produites, partagées selon les principes de la science ouverte, enrichiront les recherches sur l'histoire de Montpellier ainsi que sur la langue politique et administrative de la ville médiévale : l'occitan. Cette initiative saura également sensibiliser la jeune génération à la préservation du patrimoine linguistique et aux enjeux éthiques de l'intelligence artificielle, tout en rapprochant chercheurs, étudiants et citoyens autour d'un héritage commun.

Missions
La personne recrutée aura pour mission l'édition d'un livre manuscrit occitan du Moyen Âge tardif. Elle sera formée à l'utilisation de la plateforme open source eScriptorium, système de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite (HTR) assisté par l'IA. Elle devra entraîner la plateforme à lire correctement les folios numérisés d'un livre manuscrit du XIVe siècle (principe du ML  -machine learning-) afin :

- d'éditer les 270 folios du ms. en question.

- de créer un modèle de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite tardomédiévale pour l'occitan.

CONNAISSANCES ET SAVOIRS
Bonne connaissance de la langue occitane médiévale (niveau Master ou Doctorat).

SAVOIR FAIRE OPÉRATIONNELS
IA friendly, disponibilité à l'apprentissage des plateformes de transcription des textes.

SAVOIR ÊTRE
- Écoute,
- Patience,
- Ténacité,
- Autonomie,
- Disponibilité,
- Capacité d'interaction avec les autres membres de l'équipe.

Formations et/ou expérience professionnelle souhaitables
licence ou master d'occitan avec une préprofessionnalisation en paléographie occitane à la clé, connaissance de la TEI (protocole de balisage Text Encoding Initiative).

Rémunération
Pour les personnels contractuels, par référence à la grille de rémunération de l'université soit entre 1 682 € brut mensuel et 1 996€ brut mensuel en fonction de l'expérience acquise sur des fonctions similaires et dans une catégorie d'emploi équivalente :

Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.

- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.

- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction

title: Central quality vie f/h (H/F)
description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Nacelles conçoit, intègre et assure le support et le service après-vente des nacelles d'avions. La société est un leader mondial sur le marché des avions commerciaux de plus de 100 places, des avions d'affaires et des avions régionaux. A la pointe de la technologie, Safran Nacelles propose des nacelles toujours plus intégrées au moteur, aérodynamiques, légères avec des traitements acoustiques avancés afin de contribuer à la réduction des émissions de CO2 et sonores des aéronefs.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionSafran Nacelles is looking for a VIE Digital Quality & Audit Improvement Engineer to join its Quality team in Burnley, UK.



As part of the Quality organisation, you will contribute to the development and deployment of a new digital internal auditing tool, supporting Safran Nacelles' ambition to transform and digitalise its audit practices.



This assignment will provide the opportunity to work at the intersection of Quality, digitalisation and continuous improvement, while collaborating with different teams across the organisation.



Your missions :



Working closely with the Quality team and relevant stakeholders, you will contribute to the following activities:



Support the development of a new digital internal auditing tool for Safran Nacelles, contributing to the transition towards a more digital and efficient approach to internal audits.

Contribute to the deployment of the digital auditing tool, including supporting users during implementation, preparing training materials and contributing to training sessions.

Support the definition and development of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) associated with the auditing tool, helping to monitor its adoption, performance and effectiveness.

Develop and support the implementation of processes and templates to facilitate the consolidation and analysis of audit results.

Contribute to trend analysis of audit results and associated action plans, helping the Quality team identify recurring issues, improvement opportunities and areas requiring attention.

Support the monitoring of action plans resulting from audits and contribute to the follow-up of improvement actions with the relevant stakeholders.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to the internal audit process and contribute to sharing lessons learned and best practices.

Work collaboratively with Quality, Operations, Engineering and other stakeholders to support the successful deployment and continuous improvement of the digital audit approach.

title: Responsable cellule « Open Banking » (F/H) h/f
description:
Notre activitéRejoignez un groupe de plus de 100 000 collaborateurs au cœur du développement de nos territoires et résolument tourné vers l'international ! En intégrant BPCE, vous intégrez une entreprise engagée au service du développement et de la coordination de toutes les enseignes du Groupe BPCE (Banque Populaire, Caisse d'Epargne, Crédit Coopératif, Casden, Natixis, Oney, Banque Palatine) afin de porter les ambitions du projet stratégique « Vision 2030 ». BPCE a créé le pôle Digital & Payments en 2021 pour réunir l'ensemble des métiers du digital avec l'ensemble des métiers des paiements du groupe. BPCE Digital & Payments aujourd'hui rassemble les services de paiement et du financement du commerce, le digital, l'IA et la data, l'open banking et l'innovation. Grâce aux 3200 collaborateurs travaillant au sein de marques renommées telles que Oney, BPCE Payment Services, Payplug et Xpollens, le pôle exerce une influence significative sur le marché français et européen. Il permet au groupe et à ses réseaux bancaires de s'appuyer sur des services de banque en ligne et des services de paiement aux meilleurs standards du marché. Pour plus d'informations n'hésitez pas à parcourir notre site : https://www.digital-payments.groupebpce.com/ Vos missions au sein de l'équipeLa direction Innovation & Open Banking du groupe BPCE a pour principales missions de piloter une veille marketing stratégique, d'impulser des transformations business en rupture et de gérer les relations avec les écosystèmes de partenaires innovants.

Les établissements du groupe BPCE sont soumis comme tous les teneurs de comptes aux exigences imposées par la Directive sur les Services de Paiement (DSP2) notamment en matière d'Open Banking. Ils mettent déjà à disposition des tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPPs) des interfaces API afin de fournir les services de paiement régulés : (1) d'Information sur les Comptes (AISP), d'Initiation de Paiement (PISP) et de Disponibilité des fonds (CBPII).

Depuis plusieurs années on constate une forte augmentation de l'usage de ce solutions Open Banking par les TPPs et les clients finaux qui se traduit également par une augmentation des sollicitations des tiers régulés (assistance, demandes, incidents, etc.).

A l'avenir, les exigences DSP2 sont amenées à se renforcer avec la publication à venir de la Réglementation sur les Services de Paiement (RSP) et au-delà du volet réglementaire le groupe BPCE s'est inscrit dans une démarche Open Finance business.
Compte tenu de ces enjeux réglementaires, business et de satisfaction client, le groupe BPCE fait évoluer son « dispositif Open » et souhaite renforcer la gestion de la relation entre les établissements du groupe et les TPPs ainsi que les activités transverses de coordination et de reportings.

Au sein de l'équipe « Innovation Produit et Ecosystèmes », le/la responsable de la Cellule « Open Banking » est le garant de la relation entre BPCE et les partenaires qui se connectent aux données et services du groupe BPCE aussi bien dans le cadre réglementaire (Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2), Règlement sur les services de paiement - RSP), que dans le cadre de relations d'affaires. Dans ce cadre, les principales missions du responsable de la Cellule Open Banking seront de :

- Piloter la relation avec nos partenaires tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPP) dans le cadre de la Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2)
- Coordonner les actions de support en lien avec les directions informatiques et digitales du groupe
- Coordonner l'instruction des incidents et demandes spécifiques et critiques
- Réaliser le reporting interne sur l'activité Open Banking
- Participer à l'évolution des dispositifs pour garantir une qualité de service au standard d marché
- Participer à la coordination des projets d'évolution sur le périmètre Open Banking
- Gérer les évolutions du portail API STORE du groupe BPCE transverse aux différentes lignes métiers du groupe et à destination des partenaires ;
- Participer aux activités de veille et d'écoute des besoins du marché en matière de finance embarquée
- Participer aux activités commerciales relatives aux produits API BusinessVos atouts pour réussirCompétences attendues :

- Connaissance des réglementations sur les services bancaires et les services de paiement notamment sur l'Open Banking (Règlement IP, DSP2, RSP, etc.)
- Connaissance des écosystèmes de startup, fintechs
- Capacité à animer des équipes pluridisciplinaires (produit, tech, business) de façon transverse
- Capacité à conduire et accompagner fonctionnellement des équipes dans le changement
- Esprit d'équipe
- Aisance relationnelle
- Capacité de synthèse et vulgarisation
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (lu, écrit, parlé) indispensable pour interagir avec les partenaires internationaux.

Formation et Expérience :

- Formation supérieure (Bac+5)
- Expérience de 3 à 5 ans minimum dans le secteur bancaire, une Fintech, un cabinet de conseil ou u...

title: Nurse
description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

www.ill.eu/careers

title: Koordinatorin / Koordinator für Medizinische Netzwerke & Controlling (Fachinformatiker/in - Digitale Vernetzung)
description:
...sind Sie mittendrin

Die Stabsstelle für Medizinische Informationssysteme und Digitalisierung ist direkt dem Ärztlichen Direktor und Vorstandsvorsitzenden unterstellt und hat ihren Schwerpunkt in der Weiterentwicklung der Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen. Sie begleitet und steuert die Entwicklung medizinischer Informationssysteme aus Sicht der medizinischen Leistungserbringung und verantwortet die digitale Transformation der Universitätsmedizin Frankfurt von abgegrenzten Silos unstrukturierter Daten zur interoperablen Datennutzung für vielfältige Anwendungen und KI-Lösungen.

In einer Vielzahl an Forschungsprojekten und Kooperationen in Landes- und Bundesförderung (z.B. Das Digitale Universitätsklinikum - Der digitale Zwilling der Zukunft, das Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin, ProSReMod etc.) vereint die Stabsstelle Wissenschaft, Forschung und Anwendung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Partnern im University Center for Digital Healthcare (UCDHC).

Nicht zuletzt mit dem Krankenhausversorgungsverbesserungsgesetz (KHVVG) und dem Krankenhausreformanpassungsgesetz (KHAG) bekommt die Universitätsmedizin eine stärkere regionale und überregionale Koordinationsfunktion zugesprochen. Telemedizinische Netzwerke, regionale partnerschaftliche Verbünde, transsektorale Kooperationen werden das Gesundheitssystem von Morgen prägen.

Übernehmen Sie hierzu einen entscheidenden Part, indem Sie sich um die Gestaltung, Koordination und das Controlling unserer medizinischen Netzwerke kümmern. Langfristig besteht die Möglichkeit zur Promotion. Die Stelle ist zunächst befristet auf 2 Jahre.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- (Weiter-)Entwicklung der Universitätsmedizin-internen und externen medizinischen Netzwerkstrukturen
- Funktion als Ansprechpartnerin / Ansprechpartner für die administrativen und klinischen Stakeholder des Standortes und der Netzwerke
- Vertretung und Umsetzung des Finanzcontrollings des Netzwerks
- Koordination und Moderation interner Projekte und regionaler Kooperationen / Netzwerke im Bereich Transformation und Digitalisierung / Telemedizin
- Aufbau von intersektoralen Projektmanagementstrukturen und Nachverfolgung der Umsetzungs- und Ergebnisqualität
- Koordination, Begleitung und Unterstützung bei Antragsverfahren zur Förderung von regionalen und internationalen Strukturen sowie Recherche zu Fördermöglichkeiten
- Entwicklung von Versorgungskonzepten im Bereich Digitalisierung / Telemedizin
- Öffentlichkeitsarbeit in Abstimmung mit der Stabsstelle Kommunikation

...ist Ihr Profil gefragt

- Sie verfügen über ein wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium im Bereich Public Health, Versorgungsforschung oder Gesundheitsökonomie / -politik.
- Sie konnten bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Gesundheitswesen sammeln, idealerweise in einer vergleichbaren Position.
- Sie bringen Kenntnisse in Bezug auf einschlägige Gesetze, Verordnungen sowie fachspezifische Bestimmungen des Krankenhauswesens, über Krankenhausrichtlinien, medizinische Leitlinien, DSGVO sowie im Rahmen der Ethikvorgaben bei Projekten in einem Universitätskrankenhaus mit.
- Sie besitzen profunde Kenntnisse im Bereich der Drittmittelverwaltung und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Förderrichtlinien von Drittmittelgebern und der Wissenschaftsförderung.
- Sie punkten mit Ihren Skills in Bezug auf Projektkoordination und -management.
- Für die Stelle sind Kenntnisse über den Aufbau und die Organisation eines Krankenhauses, des ambulanten Versorgungssektors und des öffentlichen Gesundheitsdienstes essentiell.
- Zudem sind Sie routiniert im Umgang mit EDV-Softwareprogrammen wie bspw. MS Office, MS Teams, Jira, Confluence.
- Sie haben gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- Sie brennen für die Themen Digitalisierung und KI.
- Gute Präsentations- und Morderationsskills runden Ihr Profil ab.
- Aufgrund gesetzlicher Bestimmungen ist ein gültiger Nachweis der Masernimmunität / Masernschutzimpfung notwendig.

...wird Ihnen viel geboten

- TarifvertragTV-UKF
- 30 Tage Urlaub, 38,5 Stunden / Woche, Jahressonderzahlung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Promotionsmöglichkeit
- Strukturiertes Einarbeitungskonzept mit Patenmodell
- Kostenloses Landesticket Hessen
- Mobiles Arbeiten
- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés
- Work-Life-Balance, Teilzeitmöglichkeiten
- Gesundheitsförderung
- Corporate Benefits: Rabatte & Vergünstigungen bei beliebten Marken für unsere Mitarbeitenden
- Kitaplätze, Ferienbetreuung (Infos beim Familienservice)
- Einblicke: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn
- FAQ´s für neue Beschäftigte

Werden Sie jetzt Teil unseres Teams!

Mail: timm.weber@ukffm.de** **

title: Junior Controller Transfer Pricing (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER (Buchhändler/in)
description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative,efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
As part of our unit Business Reporting you take over the position as Junior Controller within our Intercompany Transfer Pricing Team.

In compliance with legal and tax regulations, internationally recognized frameworks, and BASF guidelines, you calculate, monitor, and adjust transfer prices to ensure accuracy and compliance.
You take ownership of a dedicated business area by analyzing financial statements, calculating entity-level margins, managing ad hoc requests, and conducting regular quality assurance reviews.
As a trusted business partner, you collaborate closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Controlling, while acting as a first-level escalation point to facilitate solutions and support decision-making.
You drive the continuous improvement, optimization, and automation of intercompany transfer pricing processes and contribute to effective knowledge management.
Last but not least, you support colleagues and the Global Tax Department during audits and compliance activities while continuously developing your expertise within a digitally driven and innovative organization.

- degree in Business Administration or Business Informatics with a focus on Accounting/Finance or Controlling
- background in tax related topics and a first professional experience is a plus
- strong understanding of financial statements including profit and loss statements
- familiarity with analyzing the development of financial KPIs
- strong command of MS Office Excel is a must, initial experience in the SAP environment (R/3 or S/4HANA) or Business Warehouse systems is welcome
- good communication skills in English, knowledge of other language is an advantage
- openness to learn different technology applications (e. g. VBA, Power BI or UiPath)

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience. In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success as well as individual performance.
- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according toyour needs
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression
- Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts
- Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location

HOW TO REACH US

- Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel.:+49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment.
- You can also reach our recruiting team here.
- First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video.

title: Space Safety System Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Your Tasks

- Contribute to the development of In-Orbit Servicing (IOS), Active Debris Removal (ADR), Rendezvous and Docking (RVD) missions and related applications
- Analyse customer, mission and system requirements, including functional analyses, specification tree development and identification of required design adaptations
- Perform requirements engineering activities, including the decomposition and allocation of requirements to platform and subsystem level using DOORS and Polarion
- Monitor compliance with system requirements, coordinate with the Project Chief Engineer and Project Management, and initiate appropriate corrective actions where necessary.
- Support trade-off analyses and contribute to the definition of mission and system architectures.
- Contribute to the design and development of space systems, covering mission design, system architecture, subsystem definition and technical specifications.
- Manage and maintain system-level engineering budgets, including performance, mass, power and data budgets.
- Support interface management and budget management within the assigned engineering domain
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of the system Concept of Operations (CONOPS)
- Coordinate technical activities across subsystems, including impact assessments resulting from requirement changes, under the guidance of the Project Chief Engineer
- Support the technical coordination and management of subcontractors
- Provide direct engineering support and technical reporting to the Project Chief Engineer
- Support key system engineering reviews, including PDR, CDR and verification planning activities
- Assist in the implementation of approved design changes and the management of engineering deviations and non-conformances, including RFWs, RFDs and NCRs
- Contribute to system and subsystem verification activities, including the definition of test plans, test procedures and the evaluation of test results
- Prepare and maintain project documentation by coordinating technical inputs and documenting assigned work packages
- Support the preparation of technical proposals and bids for ADR and in-orbit servicing missions
Your Qualifications

- You hold a degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical field and have gained several years of experience in Systems Engineering, ideally within the space industry or another high-tech environment
- You are familiar with the full engineering lifecycle, from requirements analysis and specification development to defining system architectures and managing interfaces across complex projects
- You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and are confident communicating with a wide range of technical stakeholders
- A structured, solution-oriented approach, combined with creativity and a collaborative mindset, enables you to successfully tackle complex engineering challenges
- Experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) and Rendezvous & Docking (RvD) would be a valuable asset. Fluency in English is essential, while German language skills are considered a plus

title: Experienced ASIC Analog Layout Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Company Description

At AUMOVIO, we own what we do: Developing and producing hardware, software, and services that shape the future of mobility. But what truly sets us apart are our people. People who thrive in our winning culture, driven by bold ideas. People who take a leap and create meaningful difference—together. Because we believe that the future belongs to those who own it. That’s why we foster a culture where you own every step of the way.
Own your career, your growth, your skills, and your impact. Join us and own what’s next.

Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions (AESS) organization has been established in AUMOVIO to develop and manufacture semiconductors in a fabless model to fulfilling strategic internal semiconductor demands.

Job Description

As an ASIC Layout Engineer (m/f/d), you will be responsible for the top-level integration of analog and mixed-signal ICs. You will drive the layout development process, ensuring robust, DRC-compliant designs with optimal area utilization. You will collaborate closely with analog circuit designers and other layout engineers to deliver high-quality silicon.

Key Responsibilities:

- Responsibility for top-level layout integration of analog/mixed-signal chips (analog on top)
- Defining toplevel floorplan, padframe design and bonding diagrams in coordination with other domains
- Coordinating with other layouters and drive floorplans according to the chip top level
- Generating and integrating analog layouts at block and chip level
- Performing pin placement, parasitic extraction, and layout optimization
- Responsibility for compliance with DRC, LVS, and support tape-out activities
- Collaborating with design engineers to meet speed, area, power, DFM, ESD, and EMC requirements

Qualifications

- Academic degree in electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics or comparable qualification
- Longterm experience in analog layout design
- Proven experience in top-level layout integration
- Strong expertise in BCD technologies (65nm to 180nm)
- Deep understanding of deep submicron effects (parasitics, coupling, matching)
- Proficient in layout tools for design, DRC, LVS, and extraction
- Knowledge of analog circuit design
- Fluent English language skills (written and spoken), German language skills are a plus

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

title: Leitung (m/w/d) Key Account Management national (Leiter/in - Key Account Management)
description:
Seit 1912 steht TRILUX als leuchtendes Beispiel für Innovation und Qualität im internationalen Lichtmarkt. Als einer der führenden Anbieter gestalten wir mit visionärem Geist und Pioniermentalität die Zukunft der Beleuchtung. Unsere technologischen Meisterleistungen, preisgekrönten Produkte und maßgeschneiderten Servicekonzepte setzen nicht nur neue Standards, sondern schaffen echte Lichtwelten - von nachhaltigen Lösungen bis hin zu intelligenten, digitalen Netzwerken, die Räume in Szene setzen und Leben bereichern.
IHR TEAM UND IHRE ROLLE

Große Kunden gewinnt man nicht allein mit guten Produkten. Entscheidend ist, ihre Organisation, ihre Herausforderungen und ihr Geschäft zu verstehen - und daraus langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln.

Unser Key Account Management Deutschland verantwortet die strategische Entwicklung unserer wichtigsten Kunden und trägt damit wesentlich zum Erfolg von TRILUX im deutschen Markt bei. Als Leitung Key Account Management Deutschland übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für diesen Bereich und führen eine bundesweit aufgestellte Organisation.

Sie bewegen sich dabei in einer Matrixorganisation, arbeiten eng mit der Geschäftsführung Deutschland und dem internationalen Key Account Management zusammen und sind Teil der ersten Führungsebene.

IHRE VERANTWORTUNG

- Sie führen das nationale Key Account Management und verantworten die nachhaltige Entwicklung des Geschäftsvolumens .
- Die bundesweite Key-Account-Organisation entwickeln Sie gezielt weiter und schaffen die Basis für profitables Wachstum.
- Die zukünftige Ausrichtung des Key Account Managements gestalten Sie aktiv mit und führen Ihre Organisation sicher durch Veränderungen.
- Unsere strategisch wichtigsten Kunden entwickeln Sie weiter und erschließen neue Geschäftspotenziale auf Entscheider-Ebene.
- Als Teil der ersten Führungsebene vertreten Sie die Perspektive unserer Key Accounts und arbeiten eng mit der Geschäftsführung Deutschland sowie dem internationalen Key Account Management zusammen.

WAS SIE MITBRINGEN

description:
Company Description

At AUMOVIO, we own what we do: Developing and producing hardware, software, and services that shape the future of mobility. But what truly sets us apart are our people. People who thrive in our winning culture, driven by bold ideas. People who take a leap and create meaningful difference—together. Because we believe that the future belongs to those who own it. That’s why we foster a culture where you own every step of the way.
Own your career, your growth, your skills, and your impact. Join us and own what’s next.

Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions (AESS) organization has been established in AUMOVIO to develop and manufacture semiconductors in a fabless model to fulfilling strategic internal semiconductor demands.

Job Description

As an Experienced ASIC Analog Design Engineer (m/f/d), you will contribute to the development of analog and mixed-signal high-voltage integrated circuits for automotive applications, such as sensor interfaces and smart power devices. You will take ownership of complex transistor-level analog designs, support analog-on-top and chip-level integration, break down requirements into block-level design targets, and mentor junior engineers. Your work will contribute to the safety, efficiency, and innovation of next-generation automotive systems.

Your Tasks:

- Responsibility for the transistor-level design of complex analog and mixed-signal circuits in coordination with other designers
- Defining and implementing analog blocks in BCD technologies, such as SMPSs, LDOs, gate drivers, charge pumps, sensor interfaces, and protection circuits
- Breaking down system-level requirements into block-level design targets and support specification clarification
- Discussing and investigating chip requirements with internal customers and align technical assumptions with stakeholders
- Collaborating with digital design, layout, verification, and test teams to support smooth chip integration
- Driving chip-level and analog-on-top integration activities, including schematic consistency, simulations, and interface alignment
- Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to knowledge sharing within the analog design team

Qualifications

- Academic degree in electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics or comparable qualification
- Expert level of experience in analog/mixed-signal high-voltage, high-power ASIC design in the automotive domain
- Longterm Experience with analog-on-top simulation environments and mixed-signal verification
- Strong Knowledge of BCD technologies
- Proven track record of tape-outs and successful silicon validation
- Knowledge of functional safety and reliability engineering
- Exposure to EMC/ESD design and robustness testing
- Strong understanding of analog circuit theory, and physical layout considerations
- Familiarity with automotive-grade design constraints and qualification processes
- Very good English language skills (written and spoken)

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

title: Sicherheitsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) (Sicherheitsmitarbeiter/in)
description:
Sicherheitsmitarbeiter (m/w/d)

- Monitoring: Du führst Kontrollrunden in Rechenzentren durch, prüfst das Gebäude und behältst alle Aspekte vor Ort im Blick.
- Alarmverfolgung: Du reagierst umgehend auf Sicherheits- und Meldetechnik, wertest Hinweise aus und leitest sie gegebenenfalls weiter.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (B2-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B1-B2-Niveau).
- Gutes technisches Verständnis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Softwaresystemen (Office365, Ticketsysteme, elektronisches Wachbuch u.a.).
- Eigenverantwortung und Hands-on-Mentalität.
- Ein einwandfreies polizeiliches Führungszeugnis, erweiterte Medienbestätigung (5 Jahre) oder idealerweise eine Security ID Number.

Übertarifliche Bezahlung: Exzellente Leistungen verdienen eine angemessene Vergütung.

- Krisensicherer Arbeitsplatz: Rechenzentren und kritische Infrastrukturen sind beständig und wachsen.
- Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis: Wir setzen auf nachhaltige Verbindungen zu unseren Mitarbeitern.
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Schulungen: Für Deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und bessere Verdienstmöglichkeiten.
- Teamorientierte Arbeitsatmosphäre: Montage müssen nicht die schlechtesten Wochentage sein - ein gutes Team macht den Unterschied.
- Attraktive Mitarbeitervergünstigungen: Profitiere von unseren Corporate-Benefits und Fitness-Programmen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: Elektrohelfer/in (m/w/d) (Elektroniker/in - Energie- und Gebäudetechnik)
description:
Elektrohelfer/in (m/w/d)

Nach vier Jahren Bauzeit sind wir Januar 2025 in unser neues Bürogebäude in Mechernich-Obergartzem gezogen. Dort bieten wir Ihnen ein modernes, offenes und angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit eine/n Elektrohelfer/in (m/w/d).

Ihre Aufgaben

- Unterstützung unserer Elektriker/innen bei der Installation von Photovoltaikanlagen
- Mithilfe bei der Montage und Installation von PV-Anlagen, Wärmepumpen und Klimageräten
- Vorbereitung und Bereitstellung von Werkzeugen, Materialien und Arbeitsmitteln
- Unterstützung beim Verlegen und Befestigen von Kabeln und Leitungen
- Zuarbeiten bei elektrischen Anschluss-, Service- und Wartungsarbeiten
- Mithilfe bei der Inbetriebnahme und Prüfung der Anlagen
- Durchführung allgemeiner Montage- und Helfertätigkeiten auf der Baustelle
- Sicherstellung von Ordnung und Sauberkeit am Arbeitsplatz
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Elektrikern und Unterstützung bei den täglichen Arbeiten

Ihr Profil

- Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Verständnis
- Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen im Elektro-, PV- oder SHK-Bereich
- Quereinsteiger mit handwerklichem Hintergrund sind herzlich willkommen
- Zuverlässige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise
- Freude an praktischer Arbeit und an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
- Körperliche Belastbarkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft
- Motivation, neue Tätigkeiten und Kenntnisse im Bereich Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpen und Klimageräte zu erlernen
- Führerschein der Klasse B

Was wir Ihnen bieten

- Keine Schichtarbeit – keine Rohbauarbeit
- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Professionelle Werkzeuge werden gestellt
- Arbeitskleidung von Engelbert Strauss
- kostenlose Getränke
- Tankgutschein in Höhe von 50 € pro Monat
- Firmenhandy Samsung oder iPhone
- Frische Brötchen und mehr – direkt in unserer Betriebskantine
- Exklusiver Mitarbeiter-Fitnessbereich
- Anfahrt: an der Autobahn A1 / kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten
- Verschiedene Firmenevents
- offenes und herzliches Arbeitsklima
- verantwortungsvoller, abwechslungsreicher und moderner Arbeitsplatz

Etwas über uns

Energie mit Zukunft – Karriere mit Sinn

Als zuverlässiger Meisterbetrieb und erfahrener Partner für Erneuerbare Energien – mit Fokus auf Photovoltaik und Wärmepumpen – setzen wir auf zukunftssichere Lösungen. Unsere qualifizierten Fachkräfte arbeiten mit hohem Engagement und Know-how für eine nachhaltige Energieversorgung in der Region. Dabei verfolgen wir klare Ziele, ein starkes Miteinander und den Anspruch, jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu werden – für unsere Kunden, unsere Umwelt und unser Team.

Was uns als Arbeitgeber auszeichnet

Bei ProSolarTec GmbH erwarten Sie spannende Aufgaben in einem zukunftsorientierten Umfeld.

Wir fördern Ihre fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch umfassende Einarbeitung, gezielte Schulungen und Weiterbildungen. Unsere offene Unternehmenskultur, klare Aufstiegschancen und ein starkes Teamgefühl machen uns zu einem Arbeitgeber, auf den Sie sich verlassen können.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Im Januar 2025 haben wir unser neues Firmengebäude bezogen. Es bietet nicht nur optimale Arbeitsbedingungen, sondern auch eine eigene Betriebskantine sowie einen Fitnessbereich – für mehr Wohlbefinden und ein starkes Miteinander im Arbeitsalltag.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

So geht es weiter

- Bewerben Sie sich bitte direkt online, indem Sie auf den "Jetzt auf diese Stelle bewerben" Button klicken.
- Ihre Bewerbung wird von uns gesichtet und wir werden uns schnellstmöglich bei Ihnen melden - versprochen.
- Danach vereinbaren wir einen Termin für ein persönliches Kennenlernen und besprechen alle Einzelheiten.
- Bei Fragen vorab können Sie gerne Kontakt zu uns aufnehmen.

Klingt das gut? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

title: IT Product Owner - EPC Project Delivery (m/f/d) (IT-Manager/in)
description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The IT Product Owner (m/f/d) for EPC Project Delivery owns the global portfolio of EPC IT applications that support the planning, control and execution of Exyte EPC projects. The role defines the product vision, roadmap and investment priorities, translates Project Delivery needs into scalable digital capabilities, and ensures products are adopted, reliable, integrated and commercially sustainable throughout their lifecycle. The role connects Project Delivery, Corporate IT and external partners to deliver measurable business value.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Define and manage the product vision, roadmap, priorities and investment portfolio for EPC Project Delivery.
- Translate common needs across Project Management, Project Controls, Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning into scalable product capabilities and measurable outcomes.
- Own portfolio lifecycle decisions, including investment, improvement, consolidation, replacement and retirement.
- Ensure products are successfully delivered, adopted, integrated, secure, reliable and supportable.
- Manage product budgets, service performance, licenses, risks, vendors and delivery partners.
- Lead the product team and establish effective governance across business stakeholders, Corporate IT and external partners.

Show your expertise

- 8+ years of experience managing digital products, enterprise applications, or technology-enabled business capabilities within EPC, engineering, construction, or comparable capital-project environments.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Project Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), experience with Primavera, SAP, RIB, SharePoint, or comparable platforms is an advantage.
- Strong expertise in product and application portfolio management, including strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, investment decisions, and lifecycle management.
- Solid understanding of EPC project delivery and construction business processes, including areas such as planning, project controls, cost management, construction, or information management.
- Good knowledge of solution architecture, systems integration, data management, cybersecurity, and IT service management.
- Commercially minded leader with experience managing budgets, software licensing, sourcing, vendor performance, and total cost of ownership.
- Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, influence international stakeholders, and drive technology-enabled transformation.
Fluency in English is required, German language skills are considered a strong advantage.
What we offer you
- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through eGym Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact

title: Staff Product Designer - (Logistics, Customer) (Produktmanager/in - Modedesign und Bekleidung)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Staff Product Designer - (Logistics, Order Tracking) to join the Order Tracking team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

Imagine shaping how millions of users track their orders across 70+ countries, ensuring a seamless and delightful delivery experience.
This role is key to ensuring our customers enjoy a delightful order tracking experience across multiple brands, including Talabat, foodpanda, PedidosYa, Glovo, HungerStation, and the rest of the Delivery Hero group of consumer apps.
You will own and shape the order tracking product, ensuring millions of customers worldwide have a seamless delivery experience.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Our mission in the Customer Product Line design chapter in Logistics is to balance internal users and customers needs, business goals and feasibility in order to build the best-in-class solutions that drive positive business outcomes.

We have 3 principles as a design chapter here:

Don't make me think! - We design the best-in-class and high-impact solutions with usability at its core, considering consistency across the products. We aim to bring trust and efficiency to our internal users in their daily tasks without compromising on the look and feel.

We help the biz to grow sustainably - We know about the business/product line strategy and OKRs like the back of our hand. That's why, whenever we propose or start a new design initiative, we consider the positive impact that it may cause on the business.

Our customers and users matter - We are responsible for bringing our users/customers and stakeholders' voices/needs to the table. We do it by research. We care about their satisfaction and consider it in our process.

- Shape the future of order tracking – This is your opportunity to lead the design efforts in revamping the order tracking experience across Delivery Hero’s brands.
- Drive impactful designs – You will own the end-to-end design process, from ideation to launch, ensuring intuitive, visually compelling, and efficient user experiences. Your designs will enhance usability while aligning with business goals and technical feasibility.
- Leverage data and insights – You will use data-driven decision-making, incorporating research insights, user feedback, and A/B testing results to refine and optimize the order tracking journey.
- Define and execute strategy – You will contribute to and refine the product roadmap, prioritizing features that drive engagement and improve the overall user experience. Your expertise in design systems will ensure consistency and scalability across platforms.
- Collaborate and Innovate – researchers, product managers, and engineers, you will co-create seamless experiences that meet both user and business needs. You will facilitate workshops and design sprints to align teams and drive innovation.
- Advocate for design excellence – You will champion best practices in visual design, accessibility, and interaction design, ensuring that every touchpoint is thoughtfully crafted. Your ability to communicate design decisions effectively will help align stakeholders across the organization.
- Be a Leader and mentor – You will help foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and user-centricity within the team, inspiring others with your design expertise and strategic thinking.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate excels in user-centric design for complex platforms, with strong visual skills and expertise in Figma and design systems. They are strategic thinkers, skilled in workshop facilitation, design metrics, and stakeholder management. A collaborative team player, they communicate effectively and drive alignment. Experience in B2C and animation is a plus.

- Experience and expertise: 5+ years as a product designer, skilled in designing complex platforms (app experience essential) and contributing to design systems.
- Design and strategy: Strong visual design skills, user-centric mindset, and strategic thinking, including workshop facilitation and design metrics analysis.
- Tools and communication: Proficient in Figma and prototyping tools, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Collaboration and bonus Skills: Team player who motivates others; experience in B2C products or animation concepts is a plus.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.

In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The Expert (m/f/d) PSM Applications owns functional design, governance, and delivery accountability across the domains, ensuring that global procurement processes are accurately translated into system solutions and consistently applied. The role provides functional leadership across system design, testing strategy, and implementation readiness, while managing risks, dependencies, and escalations within transformation initiatives.
Acting as a senior subject matter expert, the role drives process standardization, control compliance, and adoption across regions, while coaching and supporting capability development within the team. The position also contributes to continuous improvement, data-driven decision-making, and the advancement of digital procurement capabilities in alignment with global procurement strategy.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

Procurement Process & SAP S/4HANA Functional Ownership

- Own and maintain senior functional design for P2P process components within the global template
- Translate procurement policies, controls, and governance requirements into SAP S/4HANA design (processes, workflows, approvals)
- Ensure SAP Business Partner (Supplier) and procurement relevant master data concepts meet audit, reporting, and operational requirements

SAP Ariba & Supplier Lifecycle Functional Leadership

- Own functional design for SAP Ariba modules (SLP, Sourcing, Contract Management, Supplier Risk/Performance) within assigned scope
- Define and govern templates, questionnaires, workflows, and approval concepts
- Ensure end to end supplier onboarding, qualification, and due diligence processes meet compliance, legal, and sustainability requirements
- Ensure stable and compliant Ariba-S/4HANA integration from a business perspective

ERP Transformation & Delivery Leadership

- Act as senior functional expert within ERP and digital procurement transformation initiatives
- Own functional scope, risks, and dependencies within assigned work packages
- Support solution design reviews, defect prioritization, and change control decisions
- Coach and guide more junior functional experts

Governance, Compliance & Controls

- Ensure embedded process controls (approvals, SoD, traceability, master data governance) meet audit and internal control standards
- Partner with Finance, Internal Controls, and Audit on control design and evidence
- Ensure full alignment with Exyte QMS and procurement policies

Training

- Define functional content for training concepts and rollout strategies
- Ensure high quality process documentation, work instructions, and functional specifications
- Actively drive user adoption and correct system usage across regions and projects

Continuous Improvement & Thought Leadership

- Identify structural improvement opportunities across P2P and supplier lifecycle processes
- Contribute to KPI definition, interpretation, and improvement initiatives
- Act as a functional reference and coach for procurement excellence topics

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or comparable field
- 8+ years experience in procurement / supply chain with strong P2P process expertise
- Proven hands on functional experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Ariba
- Experience in global or multi regional ERP and procurement transformation initiatives
- Strong exposure to audit, internal controls, and governance requirements
- SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP Ariba certifications is a plus
- EPC, project driven, or regulated industry experience
- Strong understanding of procurement governance, controls, and data concepts
- Structured problem solving and decision making capability
- Ability to operate independently in complex environments
- International travel may be required depending on project phase

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

title: Space Safety System Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Your Tasks

- Contribute to the development of In-Orbit Servicing (IOS), Active Debris Removal (ADR), Rendezvous and Docking (RVD) missions and related applications
- Analyse customer, mission and system requirements, including functional analyses, specification tree development and identification of required design adaptations
- Perform requirements engineering activities, including the decomposition and allocation of requirements to platform and subsystem level using DOORS and Polarion
- Monitor compliance with system requirements, coordinate with the Project Chief Engineer and Project Management, and initiate appropriate corrective actions where necessary.
- Support trade-off analyses and contribute to the definition of mission and system architectures.
- Contribute to the design and development of space systems, covering mission design, system architecture, subsystem definition and technical specifications.
- Manage and maintain system-level engineering budgets, including performance, mass, power and data budgets.
- Support interface management and budget management within the assigned engineering domain
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of the system Concept of Operations (CONOPS)
- Coordinate technical activities across subsystems, including impact assessments resulting from requirement changes, under the guidance of the Project Chief Engineer
- Support the technical coordination and management of subcontractors
- Provide direct engineering support and technical reporting to the Project Chief Engineer
- Support key system engineering reviews, including PDR, CDR and verification planning activities
- Assist in the implementation of approved design changes and the management of engineering deviations and non-conformances, including RFWs, RFDs and NCRs
- Contribute to system and subsystem verification activities, including the definition of test plans, test procedures and the evaluation of test results
- Prepare and maintain project documentation by coordinating technical inputs and documenting assigned work packages
- Support the preparation of technical proposals and bids for ADR and in-orbit servicing missions
Your Qualifications

- You hold a degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical field and have gained several years of experience in Systems Engineering, ideally within the space industry or another high-tech environment
- You are familiar with the full engineering lifecycle, from requirements analysis and specification development to defining system architectures and managing interfaces across complex projects
- You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and are confident communicating with a wide range of technical stakeholders
- A structured, solution-oriented approach, combined with creativity and a collaborative mindset, enables you to successfully tackle complex engineering challenges
- Experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) and Rendezvous & Docking (RvD) would be a valuable asset. Fluency in English is essential, while German language skills are considered a plus

sowie Jahressonderzahlung gemäß AVR-DD

Ihre Aufgaben bei uns:

- **Sie begleiten und unterstützen **ein Schulkind mit Behinderung individuell durch den Schulalltag.
- Im Alltag stehen Sie zur Seite, beispielsweise bei lebenspraktischen Aufgaben, der Mobilität und einfachen pflegerischen Tätigkeiten.

Das bringen Sie mit:

- Empathie und Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern – Sie begegnen jungen Menschen geduldig, aufmerksam und auf Augenhöhe.

- **Exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte:**Sparen bei zahlreichen Onlineshops sowie bei Reisen, Fitnessstudios und Veranstaltungen mit Corporate Benefit
- **JobRad:**Umweltfreundlich und fit zur Arbeit
- Ein Grund zu feiern: Ob Drachenbootrennen, Diakonieparty, Weihnachtsfeiern oder Sommerfeste, bei uns gibt es immer einen Grund zum Feiern
- **Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende:**Kolleg:innen empfehlen und für erfolgreiche Vermittlungen attraktive Prämien sichern

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.
