title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Performance : approche fortement orientée ROI et rentabilité, au-delà des simples métriques de visibilité. Analyse : capacité à interpréter les données et à transformer rapidement les résultats en actions d'optimisation concrètes. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes et projets simultanément, à prioriser les actions et à travailler de manier/ière autonome. Qualités : autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à formuler des recommandations. Références : la capacité à présenter des cas concrets de campagnes gérées et de résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. title: Research Facilitator (m/f)
description:
Research Facilitator

(Valid from 03/09/2026 to 18/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Research Support department

Job Number: UOL08436
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Role Type: Open Position
Functions: Research support
Expertise: Research & Education Support
Job (internal): Research facilitator
Job Level: level 1

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The mission of the Research Support Department is to support the University's aim to pursuit research at the highest international standard, by working in partnership with its researchers to secure, manage and increase funding from external organisations globally, nationally and regionally. This Department communicates the University of Luxembourg's Research Strategy and Policy. The Research Support Department is responsible for providing an effective, efficient and proactive support structure to help and advice researchers on project acquisition, research execution, research management, result dissemination and exploitation. To that end, it gathers and distributes relevant information, proactively identifies sources of research funding, organises training, develops procedures and guidelines in line with the University of Luxembourg's research strategy, and develops and fosters relationships with funding agencies, other research organisations and potential sponsors.

Your role

As a Research Facilitator, you will join a collaborative team working closely with researchers and colleagues across the University. You will work within established processes and contribute to their continuous improvement to meet evolving funding, regulatory and institutional requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Support researchers in identifying national, European and international funding opportunities, e.g. FNR, Horizon Europe and other competitive funding schemes e.g. US funding, with a strong focus on quality control for national funding, e.g. FNR
• Provide a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle of research grants to provide guidance throughout the grant lifecycle, from proposal preparation to project implementation and reporting
• Produce guidelines, checklist for funding instruments and ensure regular updates and optimization of relevant communication channels and platforms
• Perform institutional validation, quality control and compliance reviews of funding applications, ensuring compliance with funders' and institutional requirements
• Contribute to the dissemination of funding opportunities, policies, procedures, and good practices within the research and research support community via relevant communication channels and platforms
• Support the optimization of digital service delivery for the performance of institutional validation, quality control, and compliance processes
• Support the organization of information sessions, workshops, training activities, and networking events
• Liaise with funding agencies, and relevant internal stakeholders and external stakeholders
• Support the institutional validation, monitoring and reporting of research projects and funding-related activities
• Maintain accurate records and contribute to the effective management of research information and data via various systems, e.g. Common Research Information System, Power BI Reports
• Contribute to the development, review and continuous improvement of processes, tools, and guidelines
• Work collaboratively with all central services, Research Facilitators across Faculties and Interdisciplinary Centres to share knowledge and promote best practices
• Contribute to the delivery of efficient, proactive, and service-oriented research facilitation services

Your profile

• Master's degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interest in research, research funding, grant management, process improvements, digital service delivery, and the higher education environment
• Service-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Ability to build constructive working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
• Previous experience in research administration, project coordination, grant preparation and management, business process improvements , digital service delivery, and research funding would be considered an advantage
• Familiarity with research funding programmes such as FNR and Horizon Europe would be considered an asset
• Excellent command in English (C1) is required. Good working knowledge of French and/or German (B1) is considered an advantage

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter

Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

Aisance dans la relation client et le conseil technique. Maîtrise de l'élaboration des devis et du suivi des offres. Bonnes capacités de négociation et de résolution de problèmes. title: Expert en informatique et cybersécurité (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration du cadastre et de la topographie, sous la tutelle du Ministère des Finances, a pour missions principales : La gestion et mise à jour de la documentation cadastrale, incluant le cadastre foncier et le cadastre vertical ; La mensuration officielle ; La gestion et mise à jour de la documentation topographique ; La gestion du système géodésique de référence national ; La gestion du registre national des localités et des rues ; L'infrastructure luxembourgeoise de données géographiques (ILDG) ; La gestion et le développement du Géoportail National du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg, en conformité avec la directive européenne INSPIRE ; L'organisation du stage professionnel, de l'examen et de l'épreuve d'aptitude pour l'obtention du titre de géomètre officiel. Missions Pilotage stratégique et budgétaire: Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route du service informatique, en alignement avec le plan de développement du CTIE et les enjeux métiers de l'administration; Élaborer et suivre le budget IT : allocation des ressources, priorisation des investissements (matériels, logiciels, services) et optimisation des coûts; Participer à la gouvernance IT : garantir la cohérence des choix technologiques avec les normes et standards étatiques (ex. : RGPD, référentiels ANSSI). Gestion des contrats et marchés publics: Superviser les contrats de maintenance des logiciels métiers : négociation, renouvellement et suivi des SLA avec les éditeurs/prestataires; Piloter des marchés publics pour l'acquisition de matériel informatique (appels d'offres, cahiers des charges, sélection des fournisseurs). Cybersécurité et conformité réglementaire: Cartographier et évaluer les risques cybersécurité spécifiques à l'ACT (Analyse des menaces et vulnérabilités, scénarios d'attaques, etc.); Mettre en œuvre la directive NIS2: Audit des systèmes existants et plan d'actions pour la conformité; Sensibilisation des équipes et coordination avec les parties prenant/antes (DSI, etc.); Gérer les incidents de sécurité : protocoles de réponse, communication de crise et retour d'expérience; Appliquer et faire évoluer les politiques de sécurité (PSSI, procédures internes, bonnes pratiques). Modernisation de l'infrastructure IT: Faire évoluer l'architecture technique: Cloud (govCloud) : migration, optimisation et sécurisation des environnements; Conteneurisation (Kubernetes) : déploiement, orchestration et monitoring des clusters; Infrastructure : serveurs s/virtuels, stockage SAN, sauvegardes et bases de données (Oracle, PostgreSQL et MariaDB). Déployer une solution de monitoring centralisée (supervision des performances, alertes, tableaux de bord); Maintenir la documentation technique à jour (schémas d'architecture, procédures, inventaires). Veille et innovation: Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire (évolutions NIS2, menaces cybersécurité, tendances DevOps); Proposer des améliorations : automatisation, résilience ou nouvelles solutions alignées avec les besoins métiers. Profil Compétences techniques Compétences métiers: Savoir appliquer la matier/ière, la législation et la réglementation du domaine concerné ainsi que posséder des connaissances en matier/ière de protection des données; Savoir faire une analyse fonctionnelle et technique des systèmes informatiques; Connaître la méthodologie associée à la gestion des opérations informatiques (ITIL) (Information Technology Insfrastructure Library); Connaître les partenaires et intervenants dans les processus liés aux systèmes informatiques; Disposer de connaissances informatiques approfondies (réseaux, administration de systèmes, bases de données, applications web, développement, bonnes pratiques en matier/ière de sécurité, sauvegarde des données, etc.); Vous savez comprendre le fonctionnement des architectures et technologies IT, en apprécier les risques potentiels au niveau technique et assister à la mise en place selon les bonnes pratiques en termes d'hygiène informatique; Disposer de connaissances ou expériences pratiques dans les domaines liés à la l'exploitation de systèmes, réseaux et virtualisation; Connaître les outils Kubernetes, Rancher, Docker; Disposer de connaissances en sécurité informatique; Avoir une bonne compréhension des architectures SAN/NAS; Avoir une expérience en administration de systèmes Linux; Avoir une expérience en scripting (Bash/Python/Powershell) ainsi que disposer des connaissances des outils d'automatisation. Compétences support: Savoir travailler de façon autonome mais également en équipe pluridisciplinaire; Être un bon communicateur; Disposer de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et orales; Être doté de fortes compétences d'analyse et savoir gérer les priorités; Avoir les capacités d'appréhender et capacité d'analyse...

title: Expert Ressources Humaines (m/f) (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Le Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS) est un établissement public en charge notamment: De l'affiliation à la sécurité sociale des salariés, travailleurs indépendants et assurés volontaires; Du calcul, de la perception et du recouvrement des cotisations sociales; De la répartition des cotisations sociales entre les différentes institutions de la sécurité sociale telles que l'AAA, la CNS, la CNAP. Le CCSS offre un cadre de travail motivant: En mettant en œuvre une mission légale essentielle pour le Luxembourg; En étant installé dans un bâtiment moderne; En étant localisé idéalement en face de la gare de Luxembourg à proximité immédiate de tous les moyens de transports, dans un quartier en renouveau et facile d'accès; En offrant la formation initiale complétée par la formation continue offerte à tous les agents du service public; En offrant une rémunération en ligne avec les conditions de la Fonction publique. Missions En tant qu'expert RH au sein du service ressources humaines du CCSS, vous rapportez directement au responsable RH. Vous l'assistez en participant activement à la gestion opérationnelle des ressources humaines du CCSS et jouez un rôle de conseiller auprès des agents et des supérieurs hiérarchiques. Vous participez aux projets RH définis dans le programme de travail et intervenez tout au long du cycle de vie RH des agents. Plus concrètement, vos missions consistent à: Accompagner et conseiller les agents dans leur évolution de carrier/ière; Fournir un support aux responsables d'unités organisationnelles dans toutes les problématiques RH et/ou organisationnelles; Organiser les examens de fin de stage, examens de promotion et de carrier/ière; Participer activement au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux agents; Accompagner le développement des compétences des agents; Participer aux projets RH définis dans le programme de travail; Développer les processus RH et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus en place; Gérer les obligations légales et statutaires liées au domaine RH; Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les collègues du service RH et le responsable RH. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience professionnelle d'au moins années, dont 5 ans minimum au sein d'un service RH dans une fonction similaire; Excellente connaissance du statut du fonctionnaire et du régime des employés et des salariés de l'Etat; Connaissance des différents processus et procédures touchant le cycle de vie RH dans la fonction publique; Connaissance des obligations liées à la protection des données (RGPD) dans la gestion des dossiers individuels; Excellente capacité à conduire un entretien individuel et fournir un conseil RH; Connaissance des principes de gestion de projet; Capacité à structurer, documenter et améliorer les processus RH; Connaissance adaptée des langues administratives; Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants. Compétences comportementales Innover : penser de manier/ière innovant/ante, apporter des idées créatives pour améliorer l'existant, encourager l'innovation; Gérer les activités : gérer les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs clairs, gérer les ressources et suivre la mise en œuvre des activités; Soutenir : agir comme référence, accompagner les collègues, les guider et les soutenir en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : fournir des conseils et développer une relation de confiance basée sur sa crédibilité, faire des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client usager; Gérer les stress : Garder son calme face à la pression, rester constructif face à la critique et agir de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Être ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, s'ouvrir à la diversité et s'intéresser à d'autres disciplines que les sien/iennes; S'autodévelopper : Bien se connaître, se remettre en question de façon régulier/ière, apprendre de ses erreurs et apprendre continuellement; S'impliquer : S'engager pour générer des résultats, assumer la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, s'engager pour le bien commun. Atouts Expérience réussie dans un service RH au sein du secteur public luxembourgeois; Connaissance des outils de la fonction publique luxembourgeoise (Toolbox, MyRH, SAP). Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The mission of the Research Support Department is to support the University's aim to pursuit research at the highest international standard, by working in partnership with its researchers to secure, manage and increase funding from external organisations globally, nationally and regionally. This Department communicates the University of Luxembourg's Research Strategy and Policy. The Research Support Department is responsible for providing an effective, efficient and proactive support structure to help and advice researchers on project acquisition, research execution, research management, result dissemination and exploitation. To that end, it gathers and distributes relevant information, proactively identifies sources of research funding, organises training, develops procedures and guidelines in line with the University of Luxembourg's research strategy, and develops and fosters relationships with funding agencies, other research organisations and potential sponsors.

Your role

As a Research Facilitator, you will join a collaborative team working closely with researchers and colleagues across the University. You will work within established processes and contribute to their continuous improvement to meet evolving funding, regulatory and institutional requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Support researchers in identifying national, European and international funding opportunities, e.g. FNR, Horizon Europe and other competitive funding schemes e.g. US funding, with a strong focus on quality control for national funding, e.g. FNR
• Provide a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle of research grants to provide guidance throughout the grant lifecycle, from proposal preparation to project implementation and reporting
• Produce guidelines, checklist for funding instruments and ensure regular updates and optimization of relevant communication channels and platforms
• Perform institutional validation, quality control and compliance reviews of funding applications, ensuring compliance with funders' and institutional requirements
• Contribute to the dissemination of funding opportunities, policies, procedures, and good practices within the research and research support community via relevant communication channels and platforms
• Support the optimization of digital service delivery for the performance of institutional validation, quality control, and compliance processes
• Support the organization of information sessions, workshops, training activities, and networking events
• Liaise with funding agencies, and relevant internal stakeholders and external stakeholders
• Support the institutional validation, monitoring and reporting of research projects and funding-related activities
• Maintain accurate records and contribute to the effective management of research information and data via various systems, e.g. Common Research Information System, Power BI Reports
• Contribute to the development, review and continuous improvement of processes, tools, and guidelines
• Work collaboratively with all central services, Research Facilitators across Faculties and Interdisciplinary Centres to share knowledge and promote best practices
• Contribute to the delivery of efficient, proactive, and service-oriented research facilitation services

Your profile

• Master's degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interest in research, research funding, grant management, process improvements, digital service delivery, and the higher education environment
• Service-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Ability to build constructive working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
• Previous experience in research administration, project coordination, grant preparation and management, business process improvements , digital service delivery, and research funding would be considered an advantage
• Familiarity with research funding programmes such as FNR and Horizon Europe would be considered an asset
• Excellent command in English (C1) is required. Good working knowledge of French and/or German (B1) is considered an advantage

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter

Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

title: Fund Operations Oversight Officer (m/f) (CDD until the end of January 2027)
description:

Your working environment

ISIM is a subsidiary of ING Luxembourg. ISIM benefits from the status of a ?Super ManCo? as it has the licenses to manage both UCITS and Alternative Investment Fund (AIF).ISIM oversees Investment funds distributed by ING Group entities.Launched in 2014, ISIM is pursuing its development and its positioning as the Management Company (?ManCo?) of ING Group and is the key tool for Investment fund solutions within the Group.ISIM is looking for a Fund Operation Oversight Officer to reinforce its team.

Oversight and controls of delegated functions (Fund Administration, Depositary Bank)

• Perform initial and periodic due diligence on the delegates
• Review and analyse the Key Performance Indicators & Key Risk Indicators of the funds (monthly review/exceptions reports from delegates)

Financial Statements and other fund reporting

• Coordinate the entire funds? audit process with Central Administration and auditors

• Review/coordinate all other fund reporting

Board reporting and meeting

• Organise the funds? board meetings
• Ensure the preparation of the board packs in collaboration with the various counterparties (Central Administration, Depositary Bank, auditors, Investment Manager)

This position is a great opportunity to:

• Develop and benefit from training on-the-job thanks to an expert team
• Join the Management Company of one of the leading banks in Luxembourg within an international environment

• Work in a convivial and dynamic environment of a human-size company but integrated within a large group
• Benefit from a wide range of tasks and some autonomy, including multiple contacts with internal and external representatives

Your profile

Knowledge and experience

• Master in economics / finance or equivalent
• Relevant experience in the fund industry (e.g. in relation with Fund Administration, Depositary Bank or audit of funds)

Skills

Knowledge of:

• regulatory requirements and fund organization applicable to both UCITS and AIF;
• fund accounting mechanisms and NAV calculation
• financial markets and products
• Excel proficiency and comfortable with numbers
• Flexible and eager to learn
• Rigorous and critical scepticism
• Sense of responsibility and autonomy
• Team player with good communication skills (both oral and written)
• Fluent in French and English is a must have.

Your work environment

ING is a global financial institution with a strong European footprint. The Group provides retail and wholesale banking services to approximately 41 million customers worldwide. With more than 60,000 employees, ING operates through an international network and offers a broad range of banking and financial services across numerous markets.In Luxembourg, ING serves private, professional and institutional clients through dedicated teams of banking specialists, benefiting from both local expertise and the resources of an international banking group.

Our client, a well-established corporate bank based in Luxembourg, is looking to strengthen its Compliance team with the recruitment of a Senior AML Compliance Officer – Chinese Speaker.
This position offers the opportunity to join an international environment and take on a key role in supporting the institution's AML/CFT framework, with particular exposure to Chinese-speaking clients and stakeholders.


Your responsibilities:

As a Senior AML Compliance Officer, you will be involved in a broad range of AML/CFT and Compliance matters, including:

Performing and reviewing AML/KYC assessments on clients and transactions;
Conducting Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on higher-risk relationships and complex structures;
Reviewing client files, source of wealth/source of funds and supporting documentation;
Performing transaction monitoring, sanctions, PEP and adverse media reviews;
Identifying, analysing and escalating potential AML/CFT risks;
Supporting the Compliance team with periodic reviews and remediation projects;
Providing advice and guidance to the business on AML/KYC-related matters;
Contributing to the development and update of Compliance policies and procedures;
Liaising with internal stakeholders and supporting interactions with relevant regulatory or control functions.


Your profile:

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in AML/KYC or Compliance, ideally within a bank or financial institution in Luxembourg;
Strong understanding of the Luxembourg AML/CFT regulatory environment;
Solid experience with complex KYC files, EDD and financial crime risk assessment;
Fluent Chinese/Mandarin is required, combined with professional proficiency in English;
French would be considered an advantage;
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
Ability to work independently while interacting effectively with international stakeholders;
Rigorous, pragmatic and business-oriented approach to Compliance.


The opportunity:

You will join an international and multicultural organisation offering significant exposure to cross-border activities and complex Compliance matters.
The position provides a high level of autonomy and the opportunity to work closely with both local and international stakeholders in a demanding but collaborative environment.
Indicative fixed salary: €80K–€110K gross per year, depending on experience and technical expertise.
If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to discuss the position confidentially, please feel free to apply.

title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

title: Customer & Engagement Operations Coordinator (m/f)
description:
Customer & Engagement Operations Coordinator (F, M, X)

The Customer & Engagement Operations Coordinator will ensure success in implementing and monitoring customer and partner engagement processes. This includes ensuring proper monitoring of pipeline management, contract processing, invoicing accuracy, sales reporting and support marketing activities to enhance operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience in sales operations, CRM tools, and financial tracking. The candidate will work closely with the sales, partner, finance, and marketing teams to streamline LuxProvide's engagement cycle.

Your role consists in:

Key Responsibilities

Marketing support and execution:

• Ensure alignment between sales, partner and marketing, leveraging the execution of a B2B marketing strategy to generate brand awareness, customer engagement, and lead conversion.
• Support marketing team for industry events, conferences, and trade shows in HPC, Data Science, AI and Quantum.
• Support webinars, roundtables, and B2B networking events to showcase LuxProvide's capabilities and customer/partner success stories.
• Gather marketing KPIs, track performance metrics, and provide feedback to optimize marketing initiatives based on data-driven insights.

Engagement & Pipeline Management:

• Assist in maintaining and updating the sales pipeline, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-ups.
• Support the CCSO in sales forecasting by consolidating pipeline data and monitoring key metrics.
• Work closely with engagement and partner teams to track opportunities, ensuring leads are correctly recorded and progressing through the sales funnel.
• Identify process bottlenecks and propose improvements to enhance sales workflow efficiency.

Contract & Proposal Administration:

• Maintain a structured contract repository, tracking key dates, renewals, and amendments.
• Assist in creating sales quotes, contract and documentation for customers and partners.

Invoice & Revenue Tracking:

• Support invoicing processes by validating contract terms, and working with the finance team to generate invoices on time.
• Support customers regarding billing issues, and support the finance team in resolving disputes.

Sales Operations & Reporting:

• Develop sales reports and dashboards, providing insights on pipeline health, revenue performance, and customer contracts.
• Assist in preparing executive reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

CRM & Process Optimization:

• Support the maintenance of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools, ensuring all data is up to date.
• Identify opportunities to improve sales efficiency, customer and partner experience through automation and process enhancements.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Sales Operations, or related fields.
• 3+ years of experience in sales, sales operations, or administrative role in a technology, SaaS, or IT services environment.
• Experience with CRM systems (odoo) and sales pipeline management.
• Strong knowledge of contract administration and invoicing in a B2B environment.
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with high attention to detail.
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate insights.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience creating reports and dashboards.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams and with external customers.

Preferred Skills & Attributes:

• Knowledge of customer lifecycle management processes, tools and compliance tracking.
• Ability to work in fast-paced, dynamic environments, managing multiple priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French; additional European languages are a plus.

Why Join LuxProvide?

• Be a key enabler in the digital transformation journey of businesses and researchers, leveraging supercomputing and AI.
• Work in a high-tech environment with exposure to cutting-edge computing solutions.
• Collaborate with a diverse team of industry experts in HPC, AI, and cloud computing.
• Opportunity to contribute to streamlining sales operations and enhancing customer experience in a growing tech-driven organization.

title: Project Manager (m/f)
description:
Your mission

As a Project Manager, you will lead selected cross-functional projects from initiation through to successful delivery.

Working closely with teams across R&D, Production, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, IT and other key functions, you will ensure that projects are delivered in line with their technical, quality, cost and timing objectives.

Your role will be to provide structure, coordination and leadership throughout the project lifecycle while anticipating risks, solving complex issues and ensuring effective communication between all stakeholders.


Your key responsibilities

Project planning and organization

You will be responsible for structuring and organizing projects to ensure clear objectives and efficient execution:

    Set up and maintain project structures, including project timelines, team organization, budgets and resource planning

    Develop detailed project plans covering milestones, work plans, critical paths, risk management, cost and benefit analysis, staffing requirements and budgets

    Define, agree on and cascade project objectives to all relevant stakeholders

    Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure that everyone works towards common objectives

    Organize project meetings and key review sessions, including technical reviews and launch readiness reviews

    Assign and coordinate the activities required from the different functions involved in the project

    Monitor project progress and follow up on the completion of actions to ensure the project is delivered on time


Project coordination and prioritization

In a dynamic environment where multiple requests and priorities may arise simultaneously, you will play a key role in ensuring that project resources are focused on the right activities:

    Analyze, filter and prioritize incoming requests based on project priorities, business needs and available resources

    Ensure that the prioritization of customer requests is aligned and agreed upon with the Sales team

    Manage competing priorities and support teams in maintaining focus on the most critical activities

    Coordinate the different departments involved in the project, including Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, IT and Sales

    Ensure alignment between project requirements, operational capabilities and available resources


Project performance and risk management

You will actively monitor project performance and identify potential risks before they impact project delivery:

    Systematically identify, assess and manage technical, financial, operational and project-related risks

    Develop and coordinate appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

    Monitor project performance against customer and internal targets

    Ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality requirements, development budgets, cost objectives and project milestones

    Manage project cost calculations in collaboration with Purchasing, Production and Controlling

    Monitor project profitability and contribute to the achievement of internal financial objectives

    Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team whenever possible

    Escalate critical issues to management when they cannot be resolved within the project team

    Make informed decisions based on technical, financial, quality and timing considerations


Customer and supplier coordination

You will contribute to ensuring efficient coordination with external stakeholders while working closely with the relevant internal teams:

    Support customer communication regarding project timing, project status, changes and key milestones

    Coordinate customer-related actions in close collaboration with the Sales department

    Help ensure that customer expectations and requirements are clearly communicated internally

    Support the preparation of customer communications using the appropriate language and format

    Coordinate supplier-related activities and support communication with suppliers in collaboration with the Purchasing department

    Follow up on supplier-related actions that may impact project timing, cost, quality or technical requirements


Communication, reporting and documentation

Clear and reliable communication will be essential to the successful delivery of your projects:

    Communicate project objectives, priorities and progress to the project team and management

    Prepare and contribute to project reviews, progress reports and management updates

    Ensure that project documentation is complete, accurate and regularly updated

    Maintain project plans, action lists, risk assessments, meeting minutes and other key project records

    Record and distribute meeting minutes and ensure appropriate follow-up of agreed actions

    Use and maintain project management databases and centralized information systems to ensure reliable and consistent information

    Encourage the use of common project management tools and processes to maintain a single and reliable source of information

    Provide timely feedback on project team performance to the relevant functional managers when appropriate



Your profile

Education and technical background

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field

    A Master's degree would be considered an advantage

    Strong ability to understand, analyze and absorb technical information

    Knowledge of beverage systems would be a strong advantage

    Knowledge of valves and pressure regulators would also be highly appreciated


Professional experience

    At least 5 years of experience in project or program management

    Previous experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment

    Experience in sectors such as Medical, Automotive or Food & Beverage would be considered an advantage

    Proven experience managing complex and cross-functional projects

    Solid understanding of project management methodologies, tools and techniques

    Experience managing project budgets, costs and financial aspects would be an advantage

    Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling and resource management

Languages

Your professional strengths

title: Junior Auditor (m/f/d)
description:
Description de tâches:


Join our Audit Recruitment Days – 22 and 23 October 2026


Make your mark:

Forget the traditional job interview process. KPMG Luxembourg's Audit Recruitment Days are a two-day immersive experience  designed to give you a real feel for what it means to be an Auditor at KPMG. Through interactive challenges, innovative assessment activities you'll get the chance to explore how modern audit is evolving while also getting to know our people, our culture and life in Luxembourg, all while being considered for a career opportunity at KPMG Luxembourg..

Audit is evolving rapidly. Emerging technologies, data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming the profession, creating exciting opportunities for curious minds who combine strong business understanding with a passion for innovation.

Whether your background is in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering or Technology, the Recruitment Days will allow you to experience how modern Audit combines professional judgment, technology and collaboration to create trust.


What to expect:

Day 1 - Step into #TeamBlue: You'll start the day at our KPMG Luxembourg headquarters where you'll kick things off with interactive presentations about KPMG and the world of Audit. After lunch, you'll dive into the Audit Tech Challenge, a collaborative activity that gives you a real taste of modern Audit in action. In the afternoon, you'll get to discover Luxembourg through a fun team-based urban rally. The day will end with a special networking dinner with our Partners and Service Line Leaders before returning to your accommodation for the night, provided by KPMG.

Day 2 - Time to shine: This is where you'll show your strengths and take part in your a business interview with our Audit professionals. Following the interview, you'll get to participate in an engaging Virtual Reality Cchallenge, meet our people in a lively speed-networking session, and have an exclusive office tour. We'll wrap the day up with lunch followed by a closing session, where a few surprises and highlights await!

The following week, you'll receive feedback because we value transparency and growth! If the outcome is positive, you will also receive a job offer to join KPMG Luxembourg.


Your future role:

As a Junior Auditor, you'll do much more than just review financial information.

You'll combine audit expertise with technology, data and innovation to help clients build trust in an increasingly digital world. Your responsibilities will include:

Applying your accounting and finance knowledge to real client engagements using IFRS, Luxembourg GAAP and international auditing standards.  
Working alongside experienced auditors to understand business processes, identify risks and deliver high-quality audits.  
Leveraging data, technology and emerging AI-enabled tools to support audit procedures and improve efficiency.  
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to solve complex business challenges.  
Contributing to innovative projects that improve audit methodologies, data analytics and digital transformation.  
Continuously developing both your audit expertise and your digital capabilities throughout your career.


Who we're looking for:

We're looking for ambitious, sharp-minded people who are ready to grow and make an impact with us at KPMG Luxembourg. If you check these boxes, we want to hear from you! Here's what you need to know:

Start date: We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2027 and January 2028.
Education: You have (or will soon have) a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Audit, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science or IT. Bonus points if you're interested in professional accountancy qualifications (e.g., IRE).
Languages: You're fluent in English, plus either French, German, or Luxembourgish.
Mindset: Analytical, curious about technology, eager to learn, collaborative and ready to embrace innovation.  
Integrity: You value quality, ethics and doing the right thing.


What's in it for you:

Your future starts here! At KPMG, you'll get:

Training and support: A full-on learning experience, including our Induction Week plus all the resources to keep leveling up.  
Career growth: Want to work in another department or in a different office? We make it part of your professional development.
Impactful work: Work with top experts, collaborate with global clients, and use cutting-edge technology to make a difference.
Fun and community: From KPMG Plage to staff parties and sports activities, we make work-life balance a reality.
Flexibility: Work from home or at different office locations – we're all about that modern work setup.
Inclusive culture: We champion diversity, gender equality, and strong support for the LGBTQ+ community. You belong here!
This isn't just another job opportunity - it's your chance to join a dynamic, forward-thinking team that values your potential. Join #TeamBlue and be part of something bigger!

title: Kundenservice / Online Presenter (Koreanisch & Englisch) – Malta (Kundendienstberater/in)
description:
Für einen internationalen Technologie- und Entertainment-Kunden in Malta suchen wir koreanischsprachige Kandidaten für eine kundenorientierte Online-Rolle in einem professionellen Studio-Umfeld.
Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – eine umfassende Schulung wird angeboten.

We are recruiting Korean-speaking Online Presenters / Customer Service Representatives for a global technology company based in Malta.

In this role, you will work from a professional studio environment, engaging with online users and delivering a high-quality, interactive digital experience. No previous experience is required — full training is provided.

Key Responsibilities

- Host and present interactive online sessions from a live studio
- Engage with users in a professional, friendly, and customer-focused manner
- Maintain high presentation and service standards at all times
- Participate in internal initiatives and promotional activities
- Follow company procedures and quality standards
- Report any operational or technical issues to supervisors
- Maintain a clean and professional working environment

Requirements

- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)
- Private health insurance from day one
- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities
- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
description:
Als deutschsprachiger Kundenbetreuer (Customer Account Advisor) bist du Teil eines europäischen Kundenserviceteams und unterstützt internationale Kundinnen und Kunden direkt von unserem Büro im sonnigen Malta aus.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: KAM Manager
description:
13 juli 2026
Over Hodes Huisvesting.
Hodes Huisvesting bestaat 100 jaar. Ooit begonnen als traditioneel bouwer, is de organisatie sinds 2017 uitgegroeid tot een moderne ontwikkelaar en producent van modulaire en circulaire huisvesting. Vanuit de locatie in Goor bouwen ze dagelijks aan leefomgevingen voor wonen, zorgen en leren, industrieel, duurzaam en met oog voor de gebruiker. Participatie vanaf de ontwerpfase en aandacht voor klimaatadaptatie, natuur inclusiviteit en sociale cohesie.
De fabriek is ingericht op lijnproductie volgens het LEAN-principe en hun Kaizen-gedachtengoed. Dat betekent: continu verbeteren, met aandacht voor aarde, mens én proces. Ze combineren vakmanschap met standaardisatie, en bouwen met biobased materialen aan modulaire woningen van permanente kwaliteit. Woningen die klaar zijn voor aanpassing, verplaatsing of hergebruik, en ontworpen zijn voor comfort, beleving en toekomstbestendigheid.
Hodes staat aan de vooravond van een nieuwe groeifase. - Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten beim Kunden.

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum im internationalen Vertrieb.
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel sowie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in Produkte, Prozesse und Märkte.

title: Zorgkundige
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Sevagram een Zorgkundige.

Minder hiërarchie, betere voorwaarden. Ontdek werken in Nederland. Werk jij als zorgkundige in België en merk je dat de werkdruk hoog is of beslissingen vaak van bovenaf komen? Net over de grens in Maastricht ligt een nieuwe kans voor je klaar. Bij Sevagram werk je in een open en informele organisatie waar jouw mening telt. Je hebt meer inspraak, korte lijnen met collega’s en leidinggevenden én vaak gunstigere arbeidsvoorwaarden dan in België. Steeds meer Belgische zorgkundigen maken deze overstap en ervaren direct het verschil.

Werken bij Sevagram

Bij Sevagram staat mensgerichte zorg centraal. Als Planetree-organisatie werken we vanuit aandacht, vertrouwen en betrokkenheid voor onze bewoners én voor elkaar.

Wat Belgische collega’s ons vaak teruggeven? Dat de werksfeer minder hiërarchisch is en dat er meer ruimte is om mee te denken en initiatief te nemen.

Met meerdere locaties in Maastricht en omgeving, vlak over de grens, is er altijd een werkplek die bij jou past!

Wij maken werken over de grens eenvoudig

De stap naar werken in Nederland lijkt misschien groot, maar je staat er niet alleen voor.

Wij begeleiden je stap voor stap bij:

  • Erkenning van je diploma (indien nodig)
  • Aanvragen van een BSN
  • Praktische zaken rondom werken als grensarbeider

Zo kun jij je focussen op wat echt belangrijk is: goede zorg leveren.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

  • Een diploma zorgkundige
  • Motivatie om te werken in een betrokken en professionele omgeving
  • Zin om samen te werken en jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen

title: Zelfstandig werkende koks I
description:
Midden in het bruisende centrum van Arnhem vind je een plek waar smaken en sfeer samenkomen: DaDa Wan Arnhem.

Bij deze eigentijdse hotspot draait alles om de levendige smaken van Aziatische streetfood, geserveerd in een modern en stijlvol interieur met een ontspannen, uitnodigende vibe. Of je nu zin hebt in een snelle, smaakexplosie of een gezellig avondje uit met vrienden, DaDa Wan Arnhem biedt een verrassende en toegankelijke culinaire ervaring die je steeds weer wil beleven. Hier proef je niet alleen het eten, maar ook de energie van de stad!

Wat neem je mee als kok?
1. Je voert voorbereidende werkzaamheden uit, waaronder het wassen van groenten, het snijden en fileren van zalm, en het snijden van lamskoteletten en rundvlees voor de bereiding van stoneplate-gerechten. Dit doe je samen met een keukenteam van circa acht collega’s, onder leiding van de chef-kok.
2. Je bereidt en maakt diverse gerechten, waarbij je tussentijdse kwaliteits- en hygiënecontroles uitvoert volgens de geldende richtlijnen.
3. Je maakt gerechten gereed voor uitgifte en voert hierbij een eindcontrole uit, waarna de bedieningsmedewerkers (of robots) de gerechten kunnen bezorgen.
4. Je plant de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en plaatst bestellingen voor voedingsmiddelen en andere voorraadaanvullingen bij vaste leveranciers. Tevens controleer je de geleverde producten op kwaliteit en kwantiteit.
5. Je houdt toezicht op de werkzaamheden van hulpkrachten, geeft instructies en stuurt waar nodig bij.
6. Voor sluitingstijd zorg je voor een schone werkplek, reinig je keukenapparatuur en -machines, en assisteer je eventueel bij het schoonmaken van de gehele keuken en het opslaan van geleverde goederen.
7. Je bent een echte teamspeler, stelt je flexibel op en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.
8. Je draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit, denkt mee over optimalisaties en helpt bij het samenstellen en aanpassen van menukaarten, recepturen en bereidingsinstructies.

Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-3 opleiding (of vergelijkbaar), met aantoonbare kennis met basis kooktechnieken.

Ben jij die fysiotherapeut met affiniteit voor ouderenzorg die graag wil werken binnen de 1e én de 2e lijn? Dan komen we graag in contact met jou!
Ter vervanging van zwangerschapsverlof zijn we op zoek naar een fysiotherapeut.
Als fysiotherapeut in het paramedisch team staat de kwaliteit van leven van onze cliënten centraal. Onze cliënten zijn divers en hebben vaak complexe zorgvragen, waarbij sprake kan zijn van meervoudige klachten. Aan de hand van deze methodiek evalueer je het behandelplan en stel je deze bij waar nodig zodat de cliënt kan werken aan realistische en resultaatgerichte doelen. Door regelmatig multidisciplinair en interdisciplinair te overleggen, kunnen we andere disciplines tijdig inschakelen. Dit draagt bij aan de resultaten van het behandeltraject en uiteindelijk ook de kwaliteit van leven van de client.
Naast de behandelingen die je biedt, verwachten we ook dat je meedenkt en bijdraagt aan onze ambitie om de eerstelijns zorg te laten groeien. Je vindt het een uitdaging om nieuwe contacten te leggen en te onderhouden, waardoor ons netwerk met samenwerkingspartners verder wordt uitgebreid. Denk hierbij aan multidisciplinaire en interdisciplinaire samenwerkingen met medisch specialisten, huisartsen, thuiszorgorganisaties.

Maar ook een veilige werkomgeving waarin je je welkom voelt en je mag zijn wie je bent. Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat bij ons hoog in het vaandel, dus je krijgt de kans op een ontwikkelingstraject - een loopbaanplan - dat past bij jouw wensen. Jouw functie
Join our team as a postdoctoral researcher in an 18-month project, starting on 1 October 2026; a later start date can be accommodated.
Chronic inflammatory kidney diseases are a major health burden. Current treatment is symptomatic with significant systemic side effects. Oligonucleotides such as antisense oligonucleotides, siRNA and mRNA provide the possibility to specifically interfere with disease-causing processes, however, these molecules critically depend on effective targeting of the disease causing target cells.
In this application-oriented project, we will take strategies for cellular targeting and activity measurement of various types of oligonucleotides coupled to targeting ligands from an early to a late preclinical stage. For this purpose, coupling protocols and analytical protocols will be optimized and activity and toxicity studies for the various types of formulations performed.
You will independently design, perform and analyse experiments aimed at improving cellular targeting and advancing these formulations towards late-stage preclinical development.
The project is directed by and conducted in close collaboration with Mercurna, a biotech company developing targeted therapies for chronic inflammatory kidney disease. Mercurna is also located in Nijmegen, enabling a close coordination of activities.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Vi er en liten organisasjon med et stort hjerte for dyr. Vi huser for tiden noe over 60 dyr, og engasjerer årlig mange frivillige, både på løpende basis og på dugnader. Nå søker vi i tillegg ekstrahjelp til de daglige dyreholdsrutinene.

Jobben består av å utføre daglige rutiner for dyreholdet, fra mating, bytte vann, møkke og gjøre rent dyrehus og vannkar/fuglebasseng, tilsyn, og klargjøring til neste fôringsrunde. Jobben innebærer å være fysisk aktiv over til dels store områder, så den rette bør ha god fysisk form, kunne jobbe effektivt, planlegge tiden godt så hver oppgave blir gjort til riktig tid, og tåle - og helst like - å være ute i all slags vær (dyras rutiner må gjennomføres hver dag uavhengig av vær).

Jobben innebærer nærkontakt med en rekke dyreslag - som hester, griser, fugler, lamaer, storfe, geiter og sauer - og det er viktig å sette seg inn i og forstå grunnprinsippene for et dyrefristed og dyreholdet her. Grundig opplæring og innføring i alle rutiner blir gitt. Det er viktig å forstå grunnprinsippene for et dyrefristed og dyreholdet her.

Vi tilbyr

  • Et meningsfylt arbeid med planter og dyr som setter pris på din omsorg

  • Grundig opplæring i alle rutiner

  • Et sted der du gjør en reell forskjell hver dag

  • Fleksibilitet (timeplanen kan til en viss grad tilpasses)

  • Et engasjert og dedikert team som sammen jobber for at dyrene skal ha det godt

Timer per uke kan diskuteres og ha en viss fleksibilitet, men vi ser for oss at den/de rette personen(e) kan jobbe mellom 2-5 dager i uken, fra 2-5 timer av gangen, med mulighet for mer arbeid etter behov og årstid. Lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dale Store gård er en litt annerledes gård, med et ideelt tilsnitt. Vi driver et andelslandbruk med grønnsaksproduksjon, et fristed for dyr , som tar imot og huser dyr fra ulike bakgrunner -noen har vært utsatt for grov vanskjøtsel, andre kunne ikke fortsette å bo der de bodde. Dyrefristedet tar imot og huser dyr fra ulike bakgrunner. Vi huser for tiden over 60 dyr. I tillegg har gårdenulike ordninger hvor mennesker kommer og deltar i gårdsdriften. Vi engasjerer årlig mange mennesker, både som frivillige på dugnad og løpende basis, og gjennom andre ordninger.
