Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

title: Leitende Ärztin, Leitender Arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie Region Bern (Facharzt/-ärztin - Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie)
description:

Bei dieser besonderen Vakanz erwartet Sie eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und einer engen interprofessionellen Zusammenarbeit. Freuen Sie sich auf eine Arbeit in einer traumhaften alpinen Lage, die Ihnen zahlreiche attraktive Freizeitaktivitäten bietet.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Die ärztliche Leitung des Bereichs, bestehend aus einer Kriseninterventionsstation, einer Tagesklinik und einem Ambulatorium in Absprache mit der Bereichsleitung
- Sie sind Verantwortlich für die Pflege aller psychiatrischen Angelegenheiten und bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen niedergelassenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, der Somatik und anderen Kooperationspartnern.
- Zudem unterstützen Sie Ihre Kollegen, wobei Ihnen dabei kompetente und engagierte Teams zur Seite stehen, die sich auf Verstärkung freuen.
- Als Mitglied des Leitungsgremiums der Psychiatrie haben Sie die Möglichkeit, relevanten Einfluss auf die strategische Ausrichtung des Gesamtbetriebs zu nehmen.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Abgeschlossene Facharztweiterbildung für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen (EU-Facharzttitel,
EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Freude an interprofessioneller und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sowie an der Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Behandlungs- und Therapieangebotes
- Sie leben eine sozialpsychiatrische, flexible, freundliche und dienstleistungsorientierte Grundhaltung
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen bei Stellenantritt nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch unmittelbar danach und mit unserer Unterstützung eingereicht werden.
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

Leistungen der Anstellung

- Gehalt zwischen CHF 170.000 und 200.000 brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit, je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung
- Aufbau und Leitung des psychiatrisch-psychotherapeutischen Ambulatoriums
- Mitgestaltung und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung des Zentrums für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie
- Der Stellenantritt kann per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung erfolgen
- Einen freien Tag. Mitarbeitende aus allen Abteilungen können an einem Ski-, Velo-, Töff-, Wander-, Fun-, Weihnachtsmarkt- oder Kulturtag teilnehmen.
- Spitaleigene KITA
- Ein Team, das in einem innovativen Betrieb ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima lebt.
- Abwechslungsreiche und sehr selbständige Tätigkeit
- Regelmäßige Supervision, interne und externe Weiterbildung

Hilfe zum Start

Das Spital arbeitet in interprofessionellen und interdisziplinären Teams, um Menschen ganzheitlich – physisch und psychisch – zu behandeln. Die hohe Weiterempfehlungsrate zeugt vom großen Vertrauen in das Spital und seine Mitarbeitenden.

Unser Team vor Ort coacht und begleitet Sie durch den kompletten Bewerbungsprozess und hilft Ihnen bei der Erlangung der MEBEKO-Anerkennung durch das SRK. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir Sie bei der Relocation in die Schweiz und bei praktischen Fragen (Anmeldung, Bankkonto, Versicherung etc.).

0049 30 34 33 16 67 oder per WhatsApp +491772513591
Internet: swissmedical.wa-jobs.de

title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

title: Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) - Remote (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
description:
Remote Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. At OnlineDoctor AG we are looking for a System engineer! Our tech stack: AI, Atlassian, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Microsoft 365, Security, Slack, Office 365. Requirements: - Proven hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 at the tenant level (user lifecycle, groups, roles, licensing, security settings, integrations)

- Strong understanding of access control principles: authentication, authorization, SSO, and identity management
- Experience administering Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence) including workflow design and governance
- Demonstrated ability to establish scalable governance standards across a tooling ecosystem and improve operations independently
- Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities are: Microsoft 365 & Identity
- Serve as the tenant-level administrator for Microsoft 365, owning configuration, security settings, and feature management
- Manage the full user lifecycle: provisioning, role assignment, license management, and offboarding
- Design and enforce access control policies, including group structures, permissions, and role-based access

Tool Ownership

- Own the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of all company tools including Slack, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and others
- Support teams in configuring workflows and collaboration structures that fit how they work
- Manage vendor relationships, renewals, and license optimization to control costs

Automation & Operation

- Build and maintain secure integrations between internal tools to improve workflow consistency and reduce manual work
- Automate repetitive operational processes such as onboarding/offboarding, license provisioning, and access requests
- Maintain clear documentation for configurations, integrations and operational procedures
- Provide reliable support, monitor critical tools and lead incident responses for outages, access issues and integration failures. Category: System Developer / Engineer Location address: Waisenhaustrasse 15, Munich, Germany. Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine startup focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to take pictures of their skin issues and receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for a Systems Administrator to take full ownership of our internal tooling landscape and IT operations. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who is self-directed, detail-oriented, and passionate about improving and professionalizing reliable, secure, and well-governed systems.

You will be the owner of our internal tool ecosystem — responsible for access control, security, integrations, cost management, and operational continuity across all platforms. You will establish clear governance and standards, improve how we provision and protect our tools, and ensure every employee has seamless, secure access to what they need.

What we offer:

- Flexibility: You decide if you want to work remote or if you prefer to visit one of our Offices (Hamburg, St. Gallen, Zürich). We offer you a flexible schedule and a working time model that suits you.
- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

Ready to Join Us?
If weve convinced you, get in touch to apply for this position. We look forward to meeting you soon!  last updated 34 week of 2026

title: Training for commercial pilot (m/f/d) ATPL program (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
After successful completion of the EFA program after about 22-24 months you will receive a Commercial Pilot License (CPL) and the Instrument Rating (IR, frozen ATPL). With this you can apply for a cockpit seat with all LHG airlines and are then "cleared for take-off".

This exciting and varied training is waiting for you:

- Comprehensive theory training in subjects such as navigation, meteorology and aviation law.
- Practical training in visual flight and instrument flight on single and twin-engine aircraft.
- Intensive simulator training, which prepares you for piloting a jet with a crew of several.

Ihr Profil:

- Current DLR certificate (should still be valid for at least 1 year at the time of application) information at www.european-flight-academy.com
- General qualification for university entrance (Allgemeine Hochschulreife/ Matura/Fachhochschulreife/Fach-/Berufs-Maturität or similar, if an examination-free proof of admission to a university of applied sciences or to a higher technical college is available)
- The prerequisite is EU or Swiss citizenship or citizenship of an EFTA member state
- You are fluent in English (B2)
- German is mandatory for the Swiss location (min. B2)
- You are at least 17 years old
- You meet the requirements for an aero-medical fitness test

AYES is a Switzerland-based Engineering and Technology company headquartered in Baden. Our core business operates across several industrial sectors, including Automotive, Aerospace, Railway, Energy, and Life Sciences. With a strong focus on innovation and engineering excellence, AYES supports clients across Switzerland, Europe, and the United States, delivering advanced R&D and technology solutions. Define and manage fuel system requirements, architecture, and interfaces throughout the full development lifecycle
Support fuel system development, integration, verification, validation, and testing activities in accordance with the V-Cycle process

Coordinate technical activities with suppliers, ensuring compliance with program requirements and timely issue resolution
Support certification activities and interface with certification authorities and internal airworthiness teams

Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline
Minimum 7 years of experience in system engineering for aircraft fuel systems (ATA 28)
Strong experience in requirements management, system development, integration, verification and validation (V&V), and testing
Experience in supplier management, certification processes, and interaction with certification authorities
Good knowledge of aerospace development standards and processes, including DO-160
Fluent English is required

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Accountabilities

Production Support:

Supply Chain & Project Support:

Qualifications

title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

description:
Night Audit (m/w/d)

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Unser Herz schlägt türkis.

Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung grossgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.

Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 95 Hotels in 13 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.

Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.

Stellenbeschreibung

Die professionelle Betreuung unserer Gäste am Empfang ist zu jeder Zeit sehr wichtig – von der herzlichen Begrüßung beim Check-In bis zur Verabschiedung, bist Du für die Frühaufsteher und Nachtschwärmer unter unseren Gästen da. Dabei kümmerst Du dich ausserdem um:

- Erstellung der Tagesabschlüsse
- Kassenführung und -abrechnung
- Bearbeitung von Reservierungsanfragen
- Frühstücksvorbereitung

Benefits:

- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Ob als Hotelprofi oder im Quereinstieg – Du passt zu uns! Denn Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Ausserdem zeichnet dich aus:

- Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg
- Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

title: INGENIEUR GENIE CIVIL - OUVRAGES HYDRAULIQUES F/H (H/F)
description:
Description du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités dans les domaines de l'eau, des ouvrages hydrauliques et du génie civil, nous recherchons un ingénieur spécialisé en génie civil/ ouvrages hydrauliques  pour rejoindre notre équipe basée en Suisse romande.
Vous participerez à des projets variés en Suisse et à l'international portant sur les barrages, digues, ouvrages fluviaux, aménagements hydroélectriques et infrastructures associées.
Vos missions principales
* Participer à la conception et au dimensionnement d'ouvrages et structures en béton ;
* Réaliser des calculs et analyses complexes en génie civil et, selon les projets, contribuer aux études géotechniques ;
* Participer aux diagnostics et expertises d'ouvrages existants ;
* Contribuer aux études et à la maîtrise d'œuvre, de la conception au suivi de réalisation ;
* Prendre en charge progressivement des études et lots techniques de manière autonome.


Qualifications

Diplôme d'ingénieur / Master en génie civil, issu d'une grande école ou université de premier plan ;
* Formation solide en structures, béton et calcul ;
* 2 ans d'expérience minimum en bureau d'études, ingénierie ou recherche appliquée ;
* Bonne maîtrise des principes de conception et dimensionnement des structures ;
* Capacité à travailler en équipe ;
* Excellent esprit d'analyse, rigueur et capacité à comprendre rapidement des problématiques complexes ;
* Français courant, bonne maîtrise en anglais
L'expérience en barrages ou ouvrages complexes est un atout.
Nous offrons
* Une forte spécialisation dans le domaine des barrages et ouvrages hydrauliques ;
* Des projets techniques à forte valeur ajoutée en Suisse et à l'international ;
* Un environnement favorisant la montée en compétence et la prise de responsabilités ;
* Une équipe dynamique et pluridisciplinaire.

title: RESPONSABLE D'ATELIER MÉCANIQUE ET FLOTTE (H/F)
description:
Alsa Suisse, forte d'une solide expérience dans le secteur du transport, déploie ses activités dans divers
domaines tels que le tourisme, les services réguliers de transports publics, le transport scolaire et le transport
alpin.
Pour diriger et renforcer l'équipe de mécaniciens et assurer la qualité et l'efficacité dans l'entretien de notre flotte,
nous sommes actuellement à la recherche de notre futur(e) Responsable d'Atelier Mécanique et Flotte.
VOTRE MISSION
Vous dirigez les opérations de maintenance de notre flotte de
véhicules en Suisse et en France voisine (180 véhicules, dont une
partie électrique), vous supervisez deux ateliers dans la ville de
Genève et vous encadrez une équipe technique de 7
collaborateurs.
FONCTIONS PRINCIPALES
Gestion opérationnelle : Responsable des opérations de
maintenance et de l'exécution du plan établi pour la flotte
assignée, en contact étroit avec l'exploitation.
Encadrement d'équipe : Répartir les tâches entre les
opérateurs pour optimiser l'utilisation des ressources tout en
maintenant l'ordre et la propreté des installations.
Contrôle & Qualité : Contrôler la production et la productivité de
l'équipe et appliquer les instructions techniques de la Direction
technique.
Budget & Planning : Participer à l'élaboration du budget annuel
de l'atelier et respecter la programmation mensuelle de
maintenance (campagnes, réformes, etc.).
Gestion des urgences : Résoudre efficacement les pannes en
cours de route.
Sécurité & Conformité : Veiller au respect des politiques de
sécurité, protection des données, prévention des risques
professionnels, qualité et environnement.
Performance & Reporting : Appliquer les mesures correctives
en cas d'écart par rapport aux KPI et élaborer les rapports,
études et projets liés à l'activité.
Suivi KPI : Suivi des indicateurs clés (coût de maintenance au
km, respect de la programmation mensuelle, disponibilité,
pannes, ISC).
Relations transversales : Relations internes avec l'exploitation
et externes avec les prestataires (contrôles techniques, etc.) et
clients externes.

title: Leitende Ärztin, Leitender Arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie Region Bern (Facharzt/-ärztin - Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie)
description:
Die Psychiatrie des Spitals in der Region Bern bietet anspruchsvolle Arbeitsplätze für Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Psychologinnen und Psychologen mit der Möglichkeit zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung mit Rücksicht auf die eigenen Ressourcen. In dem überschaubaren Betrieb prägt die Persönlichkeit jedes Mitarbeitenden die Art des Umgangs miteinander und der Zusammenarbeit. Individualität betrachten wir als Bereicherung. Die Klinik bietet Arbeitsplätze an zwei Standorten in der Berner Region und ist SIWF-anerkannt sowie eine zertifizierte Weiterbildungsstätte.

Zur Führung der Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit als

Leitende Ärztin, Leitender Arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie für die Region Bern.

Bei dieser besonderen Vakanz erwartet Sie eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und einer engen interprofessionellen Zusammenarbeit. Freuen Sie sich auf eine Arbeit in einer traumhaften alpinen Lage, die Ihnen zahlreiche attraktive Freizeitaktivitäten bietet.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Die ärztliche Leitung des Bereichs, bestehend aus einer Kriseninterventionsstation, einer Tagesklinik und einem Ambulatorium in Absprache mit der Bereichsleitung

- Zudem unterstützen Sie Ihre Kollegen, wobei Ihnen dabei kompetente und engagierte Teams zur Seite stehen, die sich auf Verstärkung freuen.
- Als Mitglied des Leitungsgremiums der Psychiatrie haben Sie die Möglichkeit, relevanten Einfluss auf die strategische Ausrichtung des Gesamtbetriebs zu nehmen.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Abgeschlossene Facharztweiterbildung für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen (EU-Facharzttitel,
EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Freude an interprofessioneller und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sowie an der Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Behandlungs- und Therapieangebotes
- Sie leben eine sozialpsychiatrische, flexible, freundliche und dienstleistungsorientierte Grundhaltung
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen bei Stellenantritt nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch unmittelbar danach und mit unserer Unterstützung eingereicht werden.
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

- Gehalt zwischen CHF 170.000 und 200.000 brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit, je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung
- Aufbau und Leitung des psychiatrisch-psychotherapeutischen Ambulatoriums
- Mitgestaltung und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung des Zentrums für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie
- Der Stellenantritt kann per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung erfolgen
- Einen freien Tag. Mitarbeitende aus allen Abteilungen können an einem Ski-, Velo-, Töff-, Wander-, Fun-, Weihnachtsmarkt- oder Kulturtag teilnehmen.

title: rdinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
description:
What you'll do
As Field Coordinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the assembly, integration, testing and commissioning of one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived. Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will help coordinate the mass assembly and testing of HGCAL detector elements ("cassettes") on the surface, their integration into the complete 250-tonne detector, and the subsequent system-level testing.

You will also contribute to the installation and commissioning of HGCAL approximately 100 metres underground within CMS, including the integration and testing of essential services such as CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and optical fibres. This role offers the opportunity to combine strong technical coordination skills with hands-on involvement in the construction and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Oversee the operation and maintenance of the HGCAL assembly and testing facilities at CERN, which include large ISO 7 cleanrooms and a large assembly hall. These areas are equipped with high-power electrical and cooling infrastructure that must be operated continuously and safely. You will be responsible for planning and organising the execution of all interventions in these facilities.
Provide technical support to physicists, engineers and technicians using these facilities. This will include liaising with the HGCAL Technical Coordinators and Safety Officer, as well as with the central CMS Technical Coordination team and CERN service groups (e.g. HVAC, electrical infrastructure, etc.).
Plan and supervise all activities related to the large-scale detector integration, including cassette insertion (Hadronic section of HGCAL - CE-H) and stacking (Electromagnetic section - CE-E), the mechanical and electrical connection between CE-E and CE-H, installation and testing of the HGCAL thermal screen (to maintain the exterior at a warm temperature while the interior is cold), and cold testing of the complete detector.
Work with the HGCAL team to plan and execute tests of "sectors" of HGCAL on the surface, and similarly when HGCAL is installed inside CMS.
Work with the HGCAL Engineering Team to ensure the safe transport of large and delicate HGCAL structures around the site, as well as the overall lowering of HGCAL into the experimental cavern.
Oversee logistics for HGCAL-related items, including detector modules, cassettes, ancillary equipment and mechanical components.

Your profile
Strong track record in planning and coordinating facilities for the assembly and testing of complex devices, such as particle detectors.
Demonstrated experience in the assembly and testing of particle detectors, particularly those based on silicon sensors, would be an advantage.
Familiarity with project planning tools such as Merlin and MS Project.
Proven ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists and technicians.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.
Operation and support of experimental facilities.
Organisation, planning and control.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
Coordinates activities and focuses team on goals and objectives; monitors progress of team towards agreed goals and takes corrective action when needed.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200090 - Mechanical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

title: Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) - Remote (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
description:
Remote Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. At OnlineDoctor AG we are looking for a System engineer! Our tech stack: AI, Atlassian, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Microsoft 365, Security, Slack, Office 365. Requirements: - Proven hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 at the tenant level (user lifecycle, groups, roles, licensing, security settings, integrations)

- Strong understanding of access control principles: authentication, authorization, SSO, and identity management
- Experience administering Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence) including workflow design and governance
- Demonstrated ability to establish scalable governance standards across a tooling ecosystem and improve operations independently
- Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities are: Microsoft 365 & Identity
- Serve as the tenant-level administrator for Microsoft 365, owning configuration, security settings, and feature management
- Manage the full user lifecycle: provisioning, role assignment, license management, and offboarding
- Design and enforce access control policies, including group structures, permissions, and role-based access

Tool Ownership

- Own the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of all company tools including Slack, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and others
- Support teams in configuring workflows and collaboration structures that fit how they work
- Manage vendor relationships, renewals, and license optimization to control costs

Automation & Operation

- Build and maintain secure integrations between internal tools to improve workflow consistency and reduce manual work
- Automate repetitive operational processes such as onboarding/offboarding, license provisioning, and access requests
- Maintain clear documentation for configurations, integrations and operational procedures
- Provide reliable support, monitor critical tools and lead incident responses for outages, access issues and integration failures. Category: System Developer / Engineer Location address: Waisenhaustrasse 15, Munich, Germany. Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine startup focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to take pictures of their skin issues and receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for a Systems Administrator to take full ownership of our internal tooling landscape and IT operations. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who is self-directed, detail-oriented, and passionate about improving and professionalizing reliable, secure, and well-governed systems.

You will be the owner of our internal tool ecosystem — responsible for access control, security, integrations, cost management, and operational continuity across all platforms. You will establish clear governance and standards, improve how we provision and protect our tools, and ensure every employee has seamless, secure access to what they need.

What we offer:

- Flexibility: You decide if you want to work remote or if you prefer to visit one of our Offices (Hamburg, St. Gallen, Zürich). We offer you a flexible schedule and a working time model that suits you.
- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

Ready to Join Us?
If weve convinced you, get in touch to apply for this position. We look forward to meeting you soon!  last updated 34 week of 2026

title: Senior Packaging Technician, Operations (m/f/d) - [R408196]
description:
The Senior Packaging Technician is responsible for independently executing clinical packaging activities in compliance with internal specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records and applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)/ Good Documentation Practice (GDP) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements. This role performs primary and secondary packaging, operates packaging and labelling systems, supports documentation and SAP transactions, coordinates routine technical tasks within assigned studies and serves as an experienced technical point of contact for day-to-day packaging activities.  

Key Responsibilities:

1. Clinical Packaging Operations
•    Performs primary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Performs secondary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Supplies ordered study material to the corresponding packaging rooms and prepares materials in accordance with the relevant SOPs.
•    Operates packaging and labelling systems in support of clinical packaging activities.

2. Technical Coordination
•    Trains and supports new technicians during onboarding and routine operations.
•    Performs administrative work related to packaging orders and clinical packaging activities.
•    Escalates problems directly to the supervisor or manager as required.

•    Performs cleaning verification for equipment and rooms and completes final cleaning verification at study closeout.
•    Executes SAP transactions related to packaging activities.
•    Prepares GMP documentation, including required photographs, and creates batch notes or comments as applicable.
•    Reviews and coordinates Packaging Technicians’ activities within the assigned area.
•    Supports the transfer of cold materials as required during daily operations.  
•    Ensures study completion and hands over completed studies to the supervisor.

3. Routine Operational Tasks
•    Performs or coordinates routine tasks such as scale adjustments, deionized water flushes, and replenishment of consumables to support operational readiness.  
•    Provides day-to-day operational support to ensure readiness of packaging rooms, equipment and materials.
•    Supports the Packaging Compliance Support team with batch pre- and post-execution reviews.  

4. Documentation & Systems
•    Assists in document preparation, control and process improvement for packaging activities.
•    Uses SAP, Word and Excel for documentation and operational support, including the accurate completion of electronic logs.
•    Ensures accurate and compliant use of SAP for clinical packaging processes.

5. Compliance & EHS
•    Performs all activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, company policies, and GMP/GDP/EHS requirements.
•    Documents activities in accordance with internal GDP requirements.
•    Conducts blinding checks in accordance with SOP requirements.  

Your Profile:

•    Completed apprenticeship, preferably in a life sciences-related field.
•    At least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical packaging, or a comparable GMP-regulated environment.  
•    Good understanding of GMP, GDP and EHS requirements relevant to packaging operations.
•    English language proficiency at B1/ B2 level or above.
•    Hands-on experience with packaging and labelling equipment and routine operational support activities.
•    Experience with documentation practices, batch records and accurate recording of operational activities.
•    Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel.
•    Ability to train and support other technicians and to serve as a technical point of contact for assigned studies.  
•    Reliable, detail-oriented and able to work independently while following procedures and compliance requirements.
•    Demonstrates strong ethics, compliance and quality mindset.
•    Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.  
•    Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset in day-to-day operations and supports the implementation of procedural changes.

THE COMPANY

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».  

We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.

Our Werthenstein BioPharma site in Schachen is where we conduct cutting-edge research, develop and analyze new biological agents and supply clinical trial products for global clinical studies. The site is also home to one of our global forensic laboratories where we carefully monitor our products through the supply chain to ensure security and safety for our patients.

Die Funktion GRC verantwortet die strategische und operative Steuerung der Themen Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz, Risikomanagement und Business Continuity Management (BCM). title: Senior Associate – Treasury Strategy & Technology
description:
Senior Associate – Treasury Strategy \& Technology  
100%  
Your Impact  
\- Strategic Advisory at the Highest Level: You will advise international corporations on complex treasury, financial risk management, and cash management challenges, with a specific focus on treasury technology, systems architecture, and digital transformation.  
\- Transformational Impact: You will help drive large\-scale, multi\-stakeholder transformation initiatives at global companies \- reshaping how treasury functions operate, create value, and leverage technology.  
\- AI \& Innovation Leadership: You will be at the forefront of applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to treasury and financial processes \- from cash flow forecasting and liquidity optimization to fraud detection, risk modeling, and intelligent automation.  
\- Thought Leadership: You will provide thought leadership and practical, actionable advice on treasury strategy, financial risk management, regulatory compliance, and the evolving role of technology in finance.  
\- Efficiency \& Value Creation: You will improve the added value, operational efficiency, internal controls, and regulatory compliance of clients' treasury functions and their supporting technology ecosystems.  
\- Collaborative Excellence: You will collaborate with a diverse, global network of highly talented experts across strategy, technology, risk, and finance \- sharing knowledge and building innovative solutions together.  
\- Diverse, International Environment: You will work across multiple industries, service areas, and geographies in a dynamic and stimulating professional setting.  
Your Skill Set  
Experience \& Qualifications  
3 \- 6 years of relevant professional experience in treasury consulting, treasury technology, financial risk management, or within a corporate treasury function with a strong systems and technology focus.  
University degree (Master's preferred) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.  
Professional certification such as CFA, FRM, CTP, or equivalent qualification, demonstrating deep expertise in financial analysis, accounting, and financial risk management.  
Technical \& Domain Expertise  
Deep financial analysis and risk management skills, including a strong understanding of financial instruments, hedge accounting, valuation methodologies, interest rate and FX risk, and treasury\-related accounting standards (IFRS 9, etc.).  
In\-depth, hands\-on knowledge of at least one leading Treasury Management System (TMS) such as FIS (Quantum/Integrity), Kyriba, Coupa Treasury, ION (IT2/Wallstreet Suite), SAP Treasury, or similar \- including implementation, configuration, and optimization experience.  
Familiarity with treasury processes and operations, including cash and liquidity management, bank relationship management, payments and bank connectivity (SWIFT, host\-to\-host), debt and investment management, and intercompany financing.  
Deep knowledge of the application of AI and machine learning to financial processes, including predictive analytics for cash forecasting, anomaly detection, natural language processing for financial data, robotic process automation (RPA), and the integration of intelligent solutions into treasury workflows.  
Understanding of the broader treasury technology ecosystem, including ERP integration, data architecture, API connectivity, cloud\-based solutions, and emerging fintech platforms.  
Personal \& Professional Attributes  
Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex financial, operational, and technical information into clear, compelling recommendations.  
Strong presentation and communication skills, with confidence and credibility when interacting with senior client stakeholders, including C\-suite executives and treasury leadership.  
An advisory and team\-oriented mindset \- you take ownership of workstreams, mentor junior team members, foster innovative thinking, and contribute to a culture of excellence.  
Comfort working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, both independently and as part of cross\-functional, international teams.  
Fluent English (written and spoken) is required; German, French, or any additional language is a strong plus.  
A commitment to expanding our global business network and leveraging your personal and professional relationships to create opportunities and deepen client trust.
