title: Agriculture Mission Lead – Earth Observation and Agricultural Decision Support
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. In agriculture, this includes challenges related to productivity, resilience, resource efficiency, environmental performance and decision support for practitioners and policymakers.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Agriculture Mission Lead, you will spearhead the agriculture focused initiative - the GeoLab Agriculture Mission - within GeoLab. You will identify high-impact challenges in Swiss agriculture through direct interchange with key stakeholders and rely on domain-relevant data and experts. Moreover, you will define ambitious mission outcomes, translate practitioner needs into research and product goals, and drive solutions through field validation and adoption.

You will work closely with other GeoLab mission teams, its Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent Agriculture Mission addressing major opportunities in productivity, resilience, resource efficiency and environmental performance
Identify operational gaps where ETH Swiss GeoLab can create distinctive value for Swiss agriculture
Engage directly with farmers, agricultural advisory services, producer organisations, cooperatives, cantonal and federal authorities, insurers, technology providers and industry partners
Identify unmet needs, operational constraints, incentives and economic drivers in agricultural practice
Translate agricultural challenges into clear research, data, product and technical requirements
Assess user value, economic viability, scalability and adoption potential
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss agricultural needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones and decision points and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with GeoLab’s Geo-Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and analyses of big data amounts - and external performers to drive field pilots, validation, operational testing and integration into agricultural workflows
Identify and mobilise strong research groups, agricultural organisations, technology companies, start-ups, service providers, insurers, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab within Swiss agricultural, scientific, policy and innovation communities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned at field events, workshops and conferences
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support knowledge transfer into agricultural practice.
In summary, you understand the realities of agricultural practice and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research, Earth observation data and data-driven technologies into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in agricultural sciences, agronomy, crop science, agricultural engineering, environmental sciences or related fields
Several years of experience applied research, program delivery or operational implementation, in agricultural practice, advisory services, agri-technology, public administration or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding in agricultural practice, production systems, agronomy and crop management
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse practitioners, public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organization. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, scalability and public value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong relevance for Swiss agriculture and with broad international impact due to the learnings from it
A dynamic, interdisciplinary and entrepreneurial environment at one of the world’s leading technical universities
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich and particularly ETH Zurich I Space
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Agriculture Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position.
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, at felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

For recruitment services the GTC of ETH Zurich apply.

description:

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland,  in areas such as natural hazards, agriculture, and forestry.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Head of Geospatial AI, you will spearhead the Geo-Intelligence Team and own the development and implementation of ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI, data and shared platform capabilities. With domain experts from academia and the tech industry, you will help define the technical strategy and architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic AI systems, geospatial tools, data pipelines and compute infrastructure.

You will work closely with Research Program Support teams (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define and implement ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI and technical strategy
Based on broad inputs, establish the target architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic systems, geospatial data pipelines, compute environments and the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform
Adopt or set technical standards, priorities, interfaces and development principles aligned with GeoLab strategy and mission requirements
Drive and lead the design, development, evaluation and operationalisation of multimodal geospatial foundation models and related agentic capabilities
Encourage, enable or direct prototyping, benchmarking, validation and integration activities
Ensure that technical work produces reliable, reusable and operationally relevant capabilities rather than isolated research demonstrators
Own and be empowered to adapt the technical roadmap and delivery of the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform, including data access, processing pipelines, model-training environments, deployment capabilities and integration with HPC and cloud infrastructure
Coordinate with CSCS, ETH units, innovation leaders and technology providers to ensure scalability, security, efficiency and maintainability
Work with the Natural Hazards, Agriculture, Forestry and future Mission Leads to translate mission requirements into technical capabilities and delivery plans
Assess feasibility, define technical milestones, allocate technical resources and resolve trade-offs between mission-specific development and reusable platform components
Redirect technical work when evidence, performance or mission priorities require it
Lead or support technical collaborations with ETH groups, research institutions, CSCS, hyperscalers, companies, start-ups and open-source communities
Structure joint development activities, evaluate external capabilities and mobilise partners where they can accelerate delivery or provide distinctive expertise
In summary, you have a track record of innovative thought-leadership and a track record in brining others along with you on a journey for which the goal may not be 100% clear at the beginning. You are a voracious learner and are able to translate ambitious scientific and operational needs into robust, scalable and reusable technical solutions.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, geo-informatics, engineering, remote sensing or a related field
Several years of experience leading technical AI/ML, geospatial data or large-scale software and platform development activities that includes interactions with user communities
Demonstrated experience defining technical architectures, guiding interdisciplinary teams and managing technical resources such as platform architectures and large-scale data processing and ML workflows
Strong expertise in machine learning and multimodal foundation models with a track record of learning and adaptability as the industry and technological tools change. This also involves experience with agentic AI, reasoning systems or related AI architectures.
Excellent understanding of geospatial AI, Earth observation and remote sensing
Experience with HPC, cloud infrastructure or distributed computing environments
Proven ability to build reliable, reusable and operational technical capabilities in a cost-effective and agile manner
Experience working with academic, infrastructure, technology or industry partners
Excellent written and spoken English; German or French is an asset
You bring strong technical judgement and the ability to set direction under uncertainty. You have an excitement for technology and a passion to use this technology to enable breakthrough research and to change lives through the results it produces. You are a fast learner and a strong listener who also has the courage to try things and pivot where expectations are not fulfilled. You are able to lead highly qualified specialists, resolve architectural trade-offs and translate mission needs into scalable technical solutions. You are structured, delivery-oriented and willing to challenge or redirect weak approaches where needed. You communicate effectively across scientific, engineering, management and industry environments and build trust while maintaining clear standards, accountability and focus on outcomes.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national competence centre for Earth observation
A senior technical leadership role with high visibility and strategic relevance
The opportunity to develop geospatial AI capabilities with direct application to societal, environmental and economic challenges
The opportunity to build novel and useful AI, data and platform capabilities for multiple mission areas
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV

- Communication: Ability to communicate effectively and influence diverse global and Local stakeholders with strong interpersonal and influencing skills in a multicultural, international environment and proven ability to build alignment.

title: Principal Process Chemist Specialist
employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Production Chimique
description:
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.

Job Description

Purpose
•    Provide technical leadership for a particular product or capability within the Process Technology (PT) environment, holding the chemistry and process know-how for assigned chemical steps.
•    Lead the local technical team in the development, introduction, and support of chemical processes for new and mature intermediates and/or active substances, in close collaboration with WMU and Global Process Technology.
•    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).
•    Support process relocation projects to external suppliers or other manufacturing sites, and coach junior chemists.

Accountabilities

General & HSE:
•    Ensure that the manufacturing process is safe and compliant with legal and internal HSE rules at all times.
•    Ensure process design meets the requirements of company and national HSEQ and regulatory standards (e.g., Chemical Reaction Hazards, PRA, Management of Change).
•    Define, plan, and control laboratory work, semi-technical, and full-scale plant trials to develop and test new or improved manufacturing processes.
•    Lead programs of scientific work, defining individual tasks and technical designs within complex, challenging projects.
•    Store project data electronically and compile technical reports to record and share experimental results.
•    Actively participate in local and global technical networks to share knowledge and stay connected with other Syngenta sites (CHMU, GBJH, etc.).
Production Support:
•    Define key process parameters and design control strategies to ensure they remain within safe and optimal limits.
•    Provide proactive technical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing plants to restore or improve production performance.
•    Deliver technological recommendations to improve plant capacity, production costs, waste reduction, and energy consumption.
Supply Chain & Project Support:
•    Understand supply chain requirements and take a leading role in delivering objectives (acting as the Technology Lead for specific Active Ingredients (AIs) when required).
•    Lead the technical transfer of manufacturing processes to third parties (outsourcing) or other Syngenta facilities in coordination with the Technology & Sourcing Manager.
•    Provide process chemistry expertise to supply chain and project teams, collaborating closely with Process Engineers.
•    Participate in the commissioning of new or modified plants as part of technical start-up teams.

Qualifications

•    Education: MSc or ideally a PhD in Chemistry, typically with post-doctoral experience.
•    Experience: Minimum of 3 years of industrial experience, ideally with NAIS and AIP knowledge.
•    Technical Expertise: Strong background in synthetic organic chemistry and good knowledge of industrial-scale manufacturing processes.
•    Process Safety: Solid understanding of process safety, reaction hazards, electrostatics, and environmental issues.
•    Change Management: Detailed knowledge of systems for process change and their potential implications on product quality (formulation, regulatory, etc.).
•    Business Acumen: Awareness of costing systems and the financial impact of PT development work on Supply Chain performance.
•    Leadership & Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously, lead complex technical projects, and coach/train junior colleagues.

What We Offer

•    A competitive salary
•    Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous training
•    Special attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hours
•    A work environment that promotes agility, diversity, and teamwork
•    Responsible and varied work in a forward-thinking company
•    On-site company restaurant

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Gasoline Blending Operator #R-018360#
employer: TRAFIGURA PTE LTD, Singapour,succursale de Genève
description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities
For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

title: Process Engineer: Automation
description:
Process Engineer: Automation

Purpose of the role  

  *  In this role, you contribute to the development of advanced technical solutions that improve assembly processes and ensure reliable end-of-line testing.
  *  Strong collaboration, structured problem-solving, and a high standard of technical quality are essential to support efficient and stable manufacturing operations.
  *  As an Automation Engineer in Industrial Engineering, you play a key role in designing, developing, maintaining, and standardizing technical solutions for assembly lines and end-of-line testing equipment.
  *  Your work directly supports the efficiency, quality, and reliability of manufacturing processes across global sites.


Responsibilities:

  *  Development of Assembly and End-of-Line Testing Equipment


  *  Execute the full development lifecycle for automated and system-controlled assembly and end-of-line testing equipment, with a focus on automation, as part of project teams.
  *  Design, build, validate, and release automation equipment and devices for production use in collaboration with VAT Group teams and external suppliers.
  *  Work with global cross-functional teams to collect user requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  *  Support global sites in the introduction of new end-of-line test processes, including the development and release of production and test equipment for new product introductions and new process requirements.
  *  Develop and implement technical solutions that meet industry standards and follow engineering best practices.


  *  Project Management and Documentation


  *  Prepare clear and accurate technical specification documents in line with applicable CE conformity requirements.
  *  Create flowcharts, layouts, and technical documentation to define requirements and support solution development.
  *  Integrate electrical and electronic components into fully functional automation systems.
  *  Develop verification plans and support quality assurance activities.


  *  Troubleshooting and Continuous Improvement


  *  Analyze, optimize, and upgrade existing automation solutions.
  *  Maintain technical documentation and ensure functional definitions remain up to date.
  *  Review user feedback and implement necessary improvements and updates.
  *  Provide third-level technical support to local sites when required.


Qualifications:  

  *  Experience with manufacturing equipment connectivity, including communication protocols and system architecture.
  *  Experience in the automation of production processes and end-of-line testing.
  *  Experience in the automation of assembly and end-of-line testing processes.
  *  Experience contributing to cross-functional projects in an industrial environment.
  *  A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics, automation, or a related field; a master’s degree is an advantage.
  *  Experience in valve technology and cleanroom environments is an advantage.
  *  Proficiency in automation platforms such as Beckhoff/TwinCAT; knowledge of Siemens systems is an advantage.
  *  LabVIEW programming knowledge is an advantage.
  *  Understanding of software architecture and data storage concepts in industrial applications.
  *  Knowledge of engineering development processes and working methods.
  *  Good communication skills in English; German is an advantage.
  *  Proactive, well organized, team-oriented, and customer-focused.

title: Market Manager - Go-to-Market
description:
Sector Manager - Go-to-Market

Purpose of the job

Define and execute the ADV go-to-market strategy by managing a high-performing global channel partner network to drive growth, increase market share, enhance sales efficiency, and expand market coverage.

Key Objectives / KPIs:

  *  Channel partner Sales growth and Contribution Margin
  *  New generated opportunities and face-2-face customer visits by ADV Account Managers
  *  Revenue by Field Sales headcount
  *  Growth rate by customer classification
  *  Reduction of transactional tasks


Responsibilities:

Channel Partner Network:

  *  Leads the negotiation, review, and amendment of distribution agreements, ensuring ongoing compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal legal policies.
  *  Defines the framework for negotiating trade agreements and discount rates led by the regional Sales Channel Manager.
  *  Monitors regular business reviews and opportunity meetings led by the Regional Sales Channel Manager.


Global Channel Partner:

  *  Build and maintain strategic relationships with global channel partners at the senior executive level and organize regular face-to-face strategic meetings and workshops.
  *  Define and drive the strategic partnership roadmap.
  *  Shape and optimize the product portfolio and product branding.


Local Channel Partner and Representatives:

  *  Establish and maintain management-level relationships with local channel partners and representatives.
  *  Define and optimize the product portfolio.
  *  Develops and continuously optimizes performance-based rating systems as the foundation for sales conditions and services provided by VAT.
  *  Monitor channel partner performance and, together with local Channel Partner and ADV Sales Leaders, decide on onboarding new channel partner or phasing out underperforming channel partner.
  *  Supports Regional Sales Channel Managers with standardized analysis tools and templates to monitor channel partner performance and conduct business reviews efficiently.
  *  Support the regional Sales Channel Manager in organizing channel partner meetings.


Digital Sales Channels

  *  Develop the ADV digital customer journey in close collaboration with the data architects to automatize transactional tasks and enhance productivity.
  *  Support channel partners with digital tools and services.
  *  Establish digital customer services in collaboration with other Business Units.


Go-to-Market Strategy:

  *  Develop and execute the annual update of the Go-to-Market Strategy.
  *  Align and reinforce market reach strategy with ADV Sales Leaders and BU Management Team.
  *  Conduct regular reviews with ADV Sales Leaders to monitor progress and implement corrective actions where necessary.


Pricing Strategy:

  *  Support the ADV PM Pricing Team in pricing initiatives and implementation.
  *  Lead sales communication for the annual price adjustment.


Qualifications:

  *  Bachelor's degree in sciences, engineering or economy.
  *  Master in Business Administration.
  *  Fluent business English skills written and spoken.
  *  4+ years working experience in B2B Sales, Account Management or Channel Management.
  *  Vacuum market experience preferred.
  *  Solid experience in managing international projects.
  *  Strong entrepreneurial mindset combined with strategic clarity to identify and capture growth opportunities.
  *  Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives at global scale, spanning processes and systems.
  *  Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  *  High level of ownership: self-driven, decisive, and accountable for outcomes.
  *  International mindset with strong cultural agility and a track record of building trust across regions.

title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.
